The trials are the heals of the trigger on the ally only (spell_heal_count, target ally): the ally is set to 1 health of a 2000000000 maximum before every cast, so each of its heals is effective and rolls; the caster stays at full health, so a chained heal of it is not effective and does not roll (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:51 and :135 take GetEffectiveHeal()), and the overheal on the ally and the effective healing on the caster are read at the end of each part and must be 0, else unmeasured. Radiant Cascade 500141 EffectChainTarget[0] 4 (TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_CHAINHEAL_ALLY): at most the ally and the caster in this setup. Residual: residual_target 0.001 with min_detectable 4 points, twice the 2-point band (ADR 0781), so at the minimum of 19386 trials both the false alert at the chance and the false pass of a 4-point deviation are at most 0.1% per pair (normal approximation); 188 parts schedule 29140 trials. Reference search 2026-11-22: nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

procs.handler: aura_ascension_sun_cleric_event (spell_script_names and spell_proc rows of 805647, rev_20260909_13_sun_cleric_completion.sql:48 and :349, spell_proc Chance 100, AttributesMask 2 triggered-can-proc): Check case 805647 (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:128) accepts a damage event of 800691, the main-hand strike that 803913 Effect[0] 142 casts (Spell.dbc), and rolls Chance(player, 805647) (ProcChance 20, AscensionSunCleric.cpp:197-206); Proc sets State(player).event (:163) before the cast at :309, and the extra cast is instant (CastingTimeIndex 1, Speed 0 for 803913 and 800691), so its own 800691 strike reaches Check while State(player).event is set and returns false at :46: an extra strike never rolls and never chains. A trial is one completed player cast of 803913 (its one 800691 strike), read as the completed casts less the events. Diagnostic run 20261122-212422 (4 parts, trigger rank 1 800626): 1174 casts of 800626 counted in total, 21 baseline and 968 player casts with the aura, so 185 extra casts in 968 player casts (19.1%); the earlier '0 extra' read compared the cast count with itself. behaviours.name: Sunslam (tick damage)
behaviours.quote: dealing ${$m1+0+$AP*0.159426} Holy damage
behaviours.observe_source: Sunslam 807973 Effect[0] aura 227 every 1000 ms triggers 805639 (DmgClass 2, melee class, Holy), BasePoints 99 (100 as read) + 70 attack power x 0.159426 = 111.16 at the reference attack power 70 (tooltip token). The fixture 984954 Reg’s Test Aura: Effect[0] aura 52 SPELL_AURA_MOD_WEAPON_CRIT_PERCENT +101 (EquippedItemClass -1, so every melee or ranged class spell crits) and Effect[1] aura 57 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE -1000 (no magic spell crits) makes the hit a crit: Unit.cpp:1731-1736 gives a melee or ranged class spell crit 100% bonus (damage x 2 before crit damage modifiers), so the crit-flagged damage is expected 2 x 111.16 = 222.32, band 5% (11). The read keeps only critical events (the crit flag of the hit is recorded), so a non-crit hit would read 0 and alert. The earlier read of 222 and 518 (at 930 more attack power) are exactly 2 x int(111.16) and 2 x int(259.4): the crit double, not a defect. Dawn 807440 is a precondition fixture (set_aura, the cast is the claim); 823764: Effect[0] aura 123 -10000 on schools 126 (no magic resistance) and Effect[1] aura 108 SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 +100% on family 33 class mask word 2 bit 29, which none of the tested spells carries. Control: no cast before, 0 damage. Reference search: coa-history spell 807973 (257 applications in 5 logs) and 805639 (4959 damage events in 11 logs, 876 crits, mean 643, no per-hit AP read possible); bindmysoul 805629 text reads "28 + 15.94% AP", an older state against Spell.dbc 805639 BasePoints 99 (100 as read, G-9, older reference); nothing found for the moving rule.

behaviours.name: Vow of the Valkyr (Solar Power per auto attack)
behaviours.quote: Auto attacks generate 1 Solar Power
behaviours.observe_source: Vow of the Valkyr 807749 text: "Auto attacks generate 1 Solar Power". Judged on the direction the tooltip states: after attacking the dummy with the Vow cast, Solar Power 500149 (StackAmount 20, Spell.dbc) is on the caster with at least 1 stack; the control phase, the same attack without the Vow, reads 0 stacks. The count the tooltip states, 1 per auto attack, is not judged by this entry: it needs the auto attacks landed in the same phase as its denominator, and that number is the outcome of the engine swing timer (two hands, one 2800 ms weapon each), which neither the tooltip nor the DBC gives. The earlier expectation of 10 stacks rested on the reading of the swings entry in the same pair and is withdrawn; the count part of the clause stays open (tool need: a same-arm read of the stacks of 500149 and the auto attacks landed). Code: AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:114 and :171-173 (automatic and damage, gain 1). Reference search: coa-history spell 807749 (138 casts in 11 logs) and 506823/506824 (1391 and 1388 off-hand and main-hand Vow auto attack events, equal in count); bindmysoul 807749 text identical to the streamed one; nothing found that gives the per-event or per-cast Fulfillment count or an auto attack Solar Power rate.

Expected gain 1: one 506821 cast per Glorious Execution, so one main hand attack, not one per damage event (2, measured before the fix on pair 20261121-021237 / -021438, build 4dc152e975e5). The before phase (no Vow) reads 4 ticks, the Vow phase gains 4: the Vow adds no tick, so the 4 attacks per weapon of sunslam_fulfillment_main and sunslam_fulfillment_off come one from each tick (Sun Cleric ADR 0027, D-148). Dawn 807440 is a precondition fixture (set_aura, the subject is Fulfillment); 984954 Reg’s Test Aura: Effect[0] aura 52 SPELL_AURA_MOD_WEAPON_CRIT_PERCENT +101 and Effect[1] aura 57 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE -1000 and 823764: Effect[0] aura 123 -10000 on schools 126 (no magic resistance) and Effect[1] aura 108 SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 +100% on family 33 class mask word 2 bit 29, which none of the tested spells carries. The Vow is cast for real between the phases (setup cast in the after phase only); the phase without it is the control. The harness counters are cumulative over the whole scenario: the effect of a phase is the gain. wait_ms 4800 covers the 4 ticks (1000..4000 ms). Weapons: the Valkyr set (2529 in each hand, Sun Cleric ADR 0025). Reference search: coa-history spell 807749 (138 casts in 11 logs) and 506823/506824 (1391 and 1388 off-hand and main-hand Vow auto attack events, equal in count); bindmysoul 807749 text identical to the streamed one; nothing found that gives a per-tick Fulfillment count beyond #13027.

behaviours.name: Vow of the Valkyr (Dawn charges around every Sunslam channel)
behaviours.quote: Fulfillment: Melee ability damage triggers an auto attack with each weapon.
behaviours.observe_source: Control for the Sunslam last-tick carrier (Sun Cleric ADR 0027, mentor decision D-150): Dawn 807440 charges on the caster after each phase's Sunslam channel. Dawn 807440 ProcCharges 10, DurationIndex 3 (60000 ms); the before phase applies it fresh (set_aura, 10 charges) and Sunslam 805629, a damaging channel (Effect[0] aura 227), spends one charge at its own cast (SpendDawn, AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp OnSpellBeforeEffects), its ticks 805639 none: 9 after the channel. The Vow phase re-sets the same aura: set_aura's SetStackAmount reapplies its effects and the Dawn reapply handler (AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:97-98) restores CalcMaxCharges, 10 (measured: pair 20261122-130317 / -130417 read 9 after each phase); it casts Vow of the Valkyr 807749 (apply-aura effects 87, 112 and 4 only, not a damaging spell, no spend) and Sunslam again: 9. Each phase is judged on its own value, not on a gain: a carrier that spent a charge on the late 4th tick (the ADR 0017 route) would read 8 in both phases. Sunslam 805629: DurationIndex 35 (4000 ms), Effect[0] aura 227 EffectAmplitude 1000 ms, AttributesEx5 0, so 4 ticks (sunslam_ticks). 984954 Reg’s Test Aura and 823764 as in sunslam_ticks. The Vow is cast for real between the phases (setup cast in the after phase only). wait_ms 4800 covers the 4 ticks (1000..4000 ms). Weapons: the Valkyr set (2529 in each hand, Sun Cleric ADR 0025).

arms.source: Mercy 504848 Effect[0] target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, EffectChainTarget 6, MaxAffectedTargets 6: the four other grouped allies are nearby allies of the target, each holds Mercy; none holds it in the uncast control
arms.reach_source: The unit filter of the chain search is TARGET_CHECK_ALLY: WorldObjectSpellTargetCheck keeps a unit when _IsValidAssistTarget holds, with no IsInPartyWith or IsInRaidWith test (Spell.cpp:9353-9358, reached through WorldObjectSpellAreaTargetCheck with the Chain reason, :9420-9479, which adds only a distance test; only TARGET_CHECK_PARTY :9359 and TARGET_CHECK_RAID :9373 test the group), so ally5 in raid subgroup 2 stands within the 10 yd hop like the party members. Mercy 504848 Effect[0] target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY with EffectChainTarget[0] 6: Spell::SelectImplicitTargetObjectTargets adds the explicit ally and calls Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets (Spell.cpp:1895-1917, :1919-1939), which asks SearchChainTargets for ChainTarget - 1 = 5 more units (Spell.cpp:2200-2300); the spell is a magic-class spell, so the search radius is the 10 yd jump radius times 5 and each hop is within 10 yd of the previous unit; no spell_jump_distance row and no script for 504848 or 503650 exists (data/sql searched), and Mercy MaxAffectedTargets 6 is read only for cone and area targets (Spell.cpp:1303, :1405)

behaviours.observe_source: 504848 Mercy Effect[0] aura 23 periodic trigger of 503650, target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, EffectChainTarget[0] 6, MaxAffectedTargets 6 (the target and up to 5 nearby allies). Reach: Mercy 504848 Effect[0] target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY with EffectChainTarget[0] 6: Spell::SelectImplicitTargetObjectTargets adds the explicit ally and calls Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets (Spell.cpp:1895-1917, :1919-1939), which asks SearchChainTargets for ChainTarget - 1 = 5 more units (Spell.cpp:2200-2300); the spell is a magic-class spell, so the search radius is the 10 yd jump radius times 5 and each hop is within 10 yd of the previous unit; no spell_jump_distance row and no script for 504848 or 503650 exists (data/sql searched), and Mercy MaxAffectedTargets 6 is read only for cone and area targets (Spell.cpp:1303, :1405). Mercy is cast at the grouped ally with four more allies grouped beside it (grouped allies are capped at 5); the Mercy aura is read on the target and, in one arm, summed over the four others: 0 in the uncast control, 1 on the target and 4 across the others after the cast. The cap of 5 nearby allies needs a seventh candidate and is not reachable with 5 grouped allies and the caster (tool need returned). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history and the bindmysoul snapshot give nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC for this value; nothing found.

behaviours.name: Solemn Priest (Gavel of Light heals twice as much)
behaviours.quote: and causes Gavel of Light to heal you for an additional $s2% of its damage dealt.
behaviours.observe_source: Gavel of Light 800611 hits the dummy and the server copies a share of its damage to the caster as 707522 (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:283-290): the share is the effect value of the passive 707521, BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($707521s1, 'heal yourself equal to $707521s1% of the damage dealt'). Solemn Priest 804269 Effect[1] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1) BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($s2) on the class mask of 707521 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 2097152): 'an additional 50% of its damage dealt', so 100% of the damage with the passive against 50% without. Both phases cast one Gavel of Light at the dummy with the caster at 50% health and +20000 attack power (a harness fixture) so that the hit is the same to 0.6% from one cast to the next (the weapon damage of 35 to 55 is lost against about 3400 of attack power (20000 / 14 x 2.4)); the first run, as a hit_ratio of the heals, could not read a heal on the caster (a hit_ratio reads the heals on the target of the cast). spell_heal_total sums every matching heal event since the scenario started (the leech_ratio note), so the after reading carries the before heal: (H + 2H) / H = 3.0, tolerance 0.15 (the 5-point band on +100%). Both phases carry the class tuning aura 887015 (-20% healing done) alike. Control: the phase without the passive. Reference search 2026-11-20: bindmysoul has no Solemn Priest entry (advancement.tsv lists the name only); coa-history spell 804269: 0 events in 186 logs; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC. Fixture 984954 ('Reg’s Test Aura') carries Effect[0] aura 52 SPELL_AURA_MOD_WEAPON_CRIT_PERCENT, BasePoints 100 (+101% weapon crit), so every Gavel hit (800611, DmgClass 2, melee) is a critical strike in both phases; the heal is a share of the damage dealt, so the ratio of the two phases is unaffected.

behaviours.observe_source: Dawnsear 554406 has a 3500 ms cast time (CastingTimes 22, Spell.dbc CastingTimeIndex 22). 300321 Solar Conduit Effect[0] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2, not the cast time), BasePoints -21 (-20, $s1), EffectSpellClassMask word 0 = 64, which in family 33 matches only Dawn 807440 (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 64). Dawn 807440 Effect[1] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME), BasePoints -1 (0% on its own), class mask word 1 = 2 = Dawnsear; Solar Conduit therefore sets Dawn's Dawnsear cast-time modifier to -20%, as merged PR #13027 states (0% on its own, -20% with Solar Conduit): 3500 x 0.8 = 2800 ms while Dawn is active. Dawn 804584 is cast for real after Solar Power 500149 is set to 20 stacks (precondition fixture, the state the clause names, not its subject). The talent is learned between the phases, so the after phase first removes the Dawn left by the first phase (807440 set to 0 stacks, precondition fixture) and casts Dawn anew with the talent known: a Dawn that is already up when the talent is learned keeps its amount computed without it. Reference search 2026-11-22: bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries "Reduces the cast time of Dawnsear by -20% while Dawn is active." (same figure); nothing else found. behaviours.observe_source: $504722s1 = 10 (504722 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT, EffectBasePoints 9 + 1; 800764 Effect[0] is the same ENERGIZE_PCT, BasePoints 9). The reference character's maximum mana is 2868 = BaseMana 1363 (player_class_stats class 27 level 60, CoA.ClassLevelSixtyStats.Enable off) + 20 + (Intellect 119 - 20) x 15 (the arithmetic of the Ancient Rites entries), so 10% is 286.8; mana is set to 1000 before the cast so the refund is not clipped by a full pool, regeneration off, and the energize events of 800764 are summed (0 before, control: nothing cast). Tolerance 1 for the integer amount. behaviours.name: Fanaticism (Horusath Blast mana cost)
behaviours.quote: and reduces their mana cost by $s2%.
behaviours.observe_source: 805628 Fanaticism Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) BasePoints 19 + 1 = +20%, Effect[1] aura 108 MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) BasePoints -21 + 1 = -20% ($s2), both on EffectSpellClassMask word index 1 (the second word) = 96, SpellFamilyFlags[1] bits 32 and 64 (Gavels, Horusath Blast). The caster's mana is set to 1000 before each cast (regeneration off) and read after a real cast of Horusath Blast 500154: ManaCostPercentage 33 of base mana 1363 = 449 (int), 1000 - 449 = 551 without the passive; -20% gives 449 x 0.8 = 359, so 641 left. Control = the phase before the learn (full cost). Tolerance 1 for the engine's integer truncation of the cost (CalculatePct, then ApplySpellMod on the int cost); a cost cut of 10% or 30% reads 9 or more off. behaviours.name: Wrath of God (pushback reduction, game time)
behaviours.quote: and reduces spell pushback suffered from damaging attacks by $s2%.
behaviours.observe_source: 301343 Wrath of God Effect[0] aura 107 SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE) BasePoints 5 + 1 = 6 ($s1), EffectSpellClassMask word 1 = 258 (Dawnsear 500146 SpellFamilyFlags[1] 2, Sunflare 800231 SpellFamilyFlags[1] 256), Effect[1] aura 149 SPELL_AURA_REDUCE_PUSHBACK BasePoints 99 + 1 = 100 ($s2). Stock pushback (Spell::Delayed) delays a cast per damaging hit, less the REDUCE_PUSHBACK percent. Four Sunflare 800231 casts (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms) at the dummy in one scenario, as the Necromancer Lich Essence entry: unhit and hit once by the striker's Light of the Naaru 41394 1000 ms into the cast without the passive, then the passive learned (a real learn) and again unhit and hit; every cast start, strike and casting poll is stamped with game_time_ms. Reduction = 1 - (reduced hit end - reduced unhit end) / (hit end - unhit end), judged in the G-19 band around 100. Reference search: nothing found beyond the tooltip and the server DBC (guide section 4).

Before the fix the enemy DoT read 4000 in both phases (b5t pair B, runs 20261122-031110 / 20261122-031311). The striker (creature 36, spell hit bonus 100) casts the spell at the caster in each phase and the amount it deals to the caster is read as the cumulative spell_damage_total, so the after reading is the control amount plus the amount of the after phase; the passive is learned between the phases (before phase: no helper, the control). The scenario runs at realm-local hour 0 (night): Daytime() is false, so the class code keeps no helper (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:315, :376) and the DoT is not reduced. The enemy DoT is Shadow Flame 22682 (Effect[0] aura 3 PERIODIC_DAMAGE, DmgClass none, Shadow, BasePoints 499 + 1 die side = 500, amplitude 1000 ms, DurationIndex 31 = 8000 ms): 8 ticks of 500 = 4000 per phase in both phases, cumulative reading 8000; tolerance 40 excludes the day reading 7600. behaviours.observe_source: Mentor D-67, Paragon O-1: a player route to a recast of Paragon inside its own 20 s aura. New Day 800600 has three SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN (195) effects with EffectMiscValue 680639, 800622 and 806121 and EffectMiscValueB 1, RecoveryTime 480000, TARGET_UNIT_CASTER (Spell.dbc); a scan of every Spell.dbc effect 165, 194, 195, 196 and 197 naming 680639 finds only New Day and the Battle Cleric helper 562316 (effect 165, not an aura, never run by AddAura), and no effect 197 whose class mask matches Paragon's family 33 flags. Each phase casts Paragon (setup cast), New Day (setup cast, its own cooldown cleared by the harness before the cast), and then Paragon again (the trigger) 1600 ms later, inside the 20 s aura (SpellDuration 18), so the trigger cast refreshes the aura in AURA_EFFECT_HANDLE_REAPPLY; the cut runs on the Paragon cast itself (AfterCast), not on the aura's handle mode (mentor D-75, Sun Cleric ADR 0012). Before that fix this entry read 299494 with the passive (pair B, build 1a61a435cece). The Paragon cooldown is read 500 ms after the trigger cast: 300000 - 500 = 299500 without the passive (control phase, 300347 not learned: the route itself), 60000 - 500 = 59500 with it as the tooltip states; tolerance 1500 ms (2.5%) excludes a cooldown 10% (6000 ms) off on both sides and the control. The wait after the first phase is 21000 ms, past the 20 s aura, so the second phase's first Paragon cast is a fresh application. Reference search 2026-11-22: merged/paragon report (fresh cast reads 59.5 s, a recast inside the aura reads 300 s through a harness reset); coa-history spell 800600: 4 SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS events in 2 logs (76, 82), and in log 82 Ceegeevalk cast Paragon 142, 146 and 159 ms after New Day (19:40:54.865, 19:52:33.548 and 20:19:05.568), each time 178 to 213 s after the previous Paragon cast, so outside the 20 s aura: the reset-then-recast pattern is played, the recast inside the aura is not shown by the logs; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC for the cooldown after such a recast.

behaviours.name: Valkyr's Grip (disarm duration)
behaviours.quote: and reduces the duration of disarm effects by $s2%.
behaviours.observe_source: 807507 Effect[1] aura 232 SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD, EffectMiscValue 3 (DISARM), EffectBasePoints -16 + 1 = -15 ($s2 = 15): disarm durations on the caster x0.85. Vehicle Disarm 13534 (D-271: DmgClass 0 aura only, never rolls a miss; replaces 8379, DmgClass 2 melee, whose strike did not apply in one expiry run of pair 20261123-003219) (Mechanic 3, aura 67 MOD_DISARM on EffectImplicitTargetA 6, Speed 0, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms in SpellDuration.dbc) landed once per phase (attempts 1) by the striker entry 36. A first design used Melt Weapon 301235 (Speed 20, 6000 ms): both runs of pair 1 read the aura 5751 ms 509 ms after the landing, 260 ms more than the full duration, the missile travel (about 5 yd at 20 yd/s) that the landing time does not include, and the margin path voids a trial when the landing offset exceeds the margin (the delta itself read -891 ms against -900 and -1791 ms against -1800); Disarms 8379 and 13534 have no travel time. Expected delta = 10000 x (0.85 - 1) = -1500 ms between the landing-corrected durations (each read plus its elapsed time since the cast); margin 50 ms plus the run's tick overshoot, unmeasured unless below 10% of the expected delta (150 ms), so a 10% deviation either side is excluded. Control: the before phase without 807507. The gap between the phases exceeds the 15 s diminishing-returns reset. Expected from the installed DBC and the tooltip; nothing from a run. Reference search (G-11), prior rounds 2026-11-22 (ledger 434 reason): coa-history and the bindmysoul snapshot give nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC for this value; nothing found.

behaviours.name: Vindicator (10% of the armor ignored with Vow of the Valkyr)
behaviours.quote: Your Glorious Execution now ignores $s1% of the target's armor while Vow of the Valkyr is active.
behaviours.expected_source: 704938 Vindicator: Effect[0] ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 12 on class mask word 2 bit 1048576 (Glorious Execution), BasePoints -11; the server rewrites it to SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_IGNORE_ARMOR_PCT, BasePoints 9 (+1 = 10, $s1), mask (0, 4096, 4), kept at 0 unless Vow of the Valkyr 807749 is on the caster (AscensionSunClericRadiance.cpp:45-53, :81-88). Glorious Execution 803913 (maximum rank) is cast and its main-hand strike 800691 (Effect[0] of 803913 triggers it; the cast itself logs no damage, the first run counted 0 hits) is observed on the dummy in two arms, each hit non-critical. Lesser Armor 673 (Effect[0] aura 22 SPELL_AURA_MOD_RESISTANCE, armor) is set on the dummy with its effect 0 amount changed to 5000 in both arms (a fixture size, not a claimed value), so the dummy's armor reads 5528 (528 pinned reference armor plus 5000) in both. Classic combat armor mitigation at caster level 60: damage kept = K / (armor + K), K = 85 x 60 + 400 = 5500 (Unit.cpp ClassicPlusCombat::ArmorConstant, as the Witch Hunter Stake entry). Treatment arm: Vindicator learned and Vow of the Valkyr 807749 on the caster (a precondition fixture by harness set_aura, the condition of the clause, not its subject); control arm: Vow active, Vindicator not learned. Ignoring 10% of 5528 armor leaves 4975.2: the mean hit ratio is (5528 + 5500) / (4975.2 + 5500) = 1.0528 (+5.28%). The band is that of the stated 10% (G-19: the larger of 5% of it and 2 points, 8% to 12%), mapped through the same formula: 8% gives (5528 + 5500) / (5085.76 + 5500) = 1.0418 (+4.18%) and 12% gives (5528 + 5500) / (4864.64 + 5500) = 1.0640 (+6.40%), so the judged band is +-1.1 points on +5.28% (band_points 1.1, the smaller side), and a server ignoring 5% (+2.57%) or 15% (+8.13%) lies outside it. The 99% half-width at 498 trials per arm was 0.87 points (prove1, 3 parts of 166), so about 1930 trials per arm give the 0.44 the pilot sizes to: 12 parts of 166. Reference search 2026-11-20: bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries the sentence ("ignores -10%", the sign an export artefact); coa-history spell 704938: 0 events in 186 logs, 803913 Glorious Execution 929 casts in 6 logs, no armor figure; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC. Sizing (batch 4): the judge reports insufficient_trials when the 99% half-width of the bonus exceeds half the band. Base pairs of this batch (20261122-012954 / -013141) read it not judged at the previous part count (12 parts); the judge's own sized_trials (the count whose half-width is 0.8 of the limit) was 1998 per arm, so the entry now runs 22 parts, at least 1.1 times that count. Residual probability of insufficient_trials per pair: the sample half-width has a relative standard deviation of about 2% at these counts and sits at 0.76 of the limit, 12 standard deviations below it, below 1e-9; a true bonus at the stated value cannot be read outside the band at this size either.

Sizing of every arm (batch 4): the judge reports insufficient_trials when the 99% half-width of the bonus exceeds half the 2-point band, 1.0 point. Without Vow of the Valkyr the strike has fewer hits per cast than the main arm, and the base pair 6 control arm (3 parts of 100 casts, 300 trials) read insufficient_trials in one run and ok in the other, because 300 trials give a half-width of about 1.12 points (the main arm's 0.87 points at 498 hits per arm, scaled by the square root of the hit count, a sizing figure and not a claimed value). The arm now runs 15 parts of 100 casts per arm: at 1245 hits per arm (the lower bound, 83% of the casts non-critical with one hit per cast) the half-width is about 0.55 points, 1.8 times below the limit, so a sample variance 3.3 times its expectation would be needed to reach it, about 70 standard deviations at 2490 degrees of freedom; the residual probability of insufficient_trials per pair is below 1e-9, and the residual probability of a false alert, a true bonus of 0 read with the interval beyond the +-2 points band, is the same order (the band is 3.6 half-widths from 0 at that size). The judge still refuses fewer trials than its power needs, so a short arm is never a pass.

behaviours.name: Sun Stride (frees the caster from a slow)

behaviours.observe_source: 680700 Sun Stride Effect[0] aura 77 MECHANIC_IMMUNITY MiscValue 7 (root) and Effect[2] aura 77 MiscValue 11 (snare). A real cast of Piercing Howl 12323 by the striker lands on the caster in both phases; the before phase (no Sun Stride cast, control) still shows the slow on the caster (read 1), the after phase casts Sun Stride on the caster 300 ms after the strike and reads the slow gone (0). Reference search 2026-11-22: bindmysoul snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries "Rush forward at a high speed for 2 seconds." and nothing on removal; coa-history spell 680700 382 SPELL_AURA_APPLIED events in 34 logs, no removal reading; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC. Landing proof: an aura_apply_count arm of 12323 on the caster reads 1 then 2 (one landed Piercing Howl per phase, counted before the removal read of the after phase and before Sun Stride, whose immunity refuses a later application); a miss or a refusal turns the verdict to alert, never to a pass on an absent slow. behaviours.name: Fanaticism (Horusath Blast effectiveness)
behaviours.quote: Increases the effectiveness of
behaviours.expected_source: Accepted model of ADR sun-cleric 0008 (mentor D-61 and D-68): the expectation is the engine arithmetic enumerated over every random roll, float32 where the code uses float, from data and stat reads only, never from a measured bonus. 805628 Fanaticism Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) BasePoints 19 + 1 = +20% and Effect[1] aura 108 MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) BasePoints -21 + 1 = -20% ($s2), both on EffectSpellClassMask word index 1 = 96 (Gavels, Horusath Blast). The effectiveness figure is not in the tooltip; it is Effect[0] of the DBC, +20%, applied to integer values. Horusath Blast 500154: mean non-critical hit 73.8708 without the passive and 88.1542 with it, ratio 1.19336, a bonus of +19.34%. Horusath arithmetic (Holy SCHOOL_DAMAGE): value 72 + int32(5 x 1.06) + irand(1, 12) from the DBC, scaled by the passive as int32(float(value) x 1.2f); no spell power term (the reference character has none) and no attack power term; the dummy resists Holy through the monster linear resistance (CoA.MonsterResistance.Enable 1, PerLevel 1.0, PerPercent 5.0: 12% average, partial resist i/10 with probabilities 20%, 45%, 30%, 5% for i = 0..3, Unit.cpp:2563-2720). Control: passive not learned. Out-of-sample arm: entry effect_horusath_oos (attack power 280, target creature 603 armor 3750; prediction commit 95f8ff6c99 written before any arm, pair 20261122-024352 / -024635, predicted +19.34%, read +19.53 / +19.18); the Horusath arm is a replication of the same engine path, not an out-of-sample test (no attack power term, no armor, and the resist is the same). Not tested: another weapon, another level, spell power. The judged band is the G-19 band, the larger of 5% of the bonus and 2 points; it is not widened. Reference search: coa-history spell 805628 and the three Gavel roots 800611, 800614, 800617: 0 events (the passive and the roots are not logged); the rank spells Gavel of Wrath 802561 (677 SPELL_DAMAGE, mean 568, 203 crits, 4 logs) and 802560 (13), Gavel of Light 502467 (2) carry no talent attribution, so they cannot settle the effectiveness; git log origin/main --grep and gh pr list --search (805628, Fanaticism, Gavel of Light, Gavel of Grace, Gavel of Wrath): merged PR #4516 (scenario sun-cleric-fanaticism: Player::ApplySpellMod reads 1000 back as 1200 and 1000 as 800, data level, no Gavel hit measured), PRs #8988 and #9558 (Gavel dodge and extra strikes, no effectiveness figure); the community snapshots carry the tooltip with no effectiveness figure (guide section 4). Sizing: the judge reports insufficient_trials when the 99% half-width of the bonus exceeds its limit. The counted pair 20261122-013639 / -013852 ran 3500 trials per arm at 0.76 and 0.76 of the limit and sized 3136 and 3136 trials per arm; the entry now runs 35 parts, 3500 trials per arm, at least 1.1 times the larger sized count (3136). At 3500 trials the half-width is at most 0.760 of the limit (the worse run scaled by the square root of the trial ratio). Residual probability of insufficient_trials per pair: the half-width's relative standard deviation is 1 / sqrt(2 x trials) = 1.20%, and the limit lies 32% above it, 26 standard deviations, below 1e-9.

behaviours.observe_source: 681436 Devoted to the Light Effect[0] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER misc 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) BasePoints -101 + 1 = -100% with EffectSpellClassMask[0..2] = 262144 / 128 / 524288 (the SpellFamilyFlags of Solar Invocation: Resplendence 806159 and Revelation 503651, Ascension 500152, Conquest 800764); Effect[1] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 504858 (Energize 5% Missing, ENERGIZE_PCT, BasePoints 4 + 1 = 5 = $504679s1) with an empty class mask; the script gives 5% of the missing mana after any of the four Invocations (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:230-233, AscensionSunCleric.cpp:167-170, source 504679, Sun Cleric ADR 0020). ManaCostPercentage of the base mana 1363 (player_class_stats class 27 level 60): Resplendence 19 = 258.97, Revelation 14 = 190.82, Conquest 5 = 68.15, Ascension 35 = 477.05; the maximum mana of the reference character is 2868 (the Conquest refund entry). Conquest 800764 Effect[0] is SPELL_EFFECT_ENERGIZE_PCT (137) on the caster, BasePoints 9 + 1 = 10% of the maximum mana ($504722s1 in the description), so it refunds CalculatePct(2868, 10) = 286 (SpellEffects.cpp:3044) even when Devoted makes the Invocation free; that refund runs in handle_immediate (Spell.cpp:4141) and Devoted's energize in the OnSpellCast hook (Spell.cpp:4191), so Devoted reads the mana after the refund, 1000 + 286 = 1286, and gives 5 x (2868 - 1286) / 100 = 79.1, truncated to 79 (CalculatePct, Util.h:52-55). Conquest 800764 is cast with the mana set to 1000, regeneration off; the energize events of source 504679, Sun Cleric ADR 0020 on the caster are summed 500 ms later: 0 before the learn (control) and 79 after, within 1.5; the refund itself is logged under 800764 and is not in that sum. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 681436: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); the positive control 504858 Energize 5% Missing has 678 SPELL_ENERGIZE events in 30 logs, 1 to 466, mean 56; bindmysoul snapshot not consulted for a value; nothing else found. The trigger carries StartRecoveryTime 1500 ms (Spell.dbc), so the after-phase cast waits 500 + 2100 ms after the first to fall outside the global cooldown.

behaviours.name: Arbiter of Light (Gavel of Light heal while Vow of Light is active)
behaviours.quote: While Vow of Light is active, your Gavel of Light now restores an additional $807549s3% health equal to the damage dealt.
behaviours.observe_source: Gavel of Light 800611 copies a share of its damage to the caster as 707522; the share is the 50 of 707521 ($707521s1), read without the caster's spell modifiers, plus Vow of Light 807549 Effect[2] BasePoints 99 + 1 = 100 ($807549s3) while the caster has Arbiter of Light 302914 and the live Vow of Light aura 807547 (Sun Cleric ADR 0014, mentor D-71: 'While Vow of Light is active' is aura 807547 present; nothing applies 807549). Vow of Light 807547 is cast on the caster before both phases (setup_casts, the same real cast as Soul of Light's vow_value entry). Expected: 100% of the damage with Arbiter's tooltip share against 50% without, so after = H + 3H with the 4H of 150% (50 + 100) against H: ratio 4.0, tolerance 0.15. Fixture 984954 makes every Gavel hit a critical strike in both phases and +20000 attack power makes the hit the same to 0.4%; the heal is a share of the damage, so the ratio is unaffected. Control: the first phase without the passive; the arm without Vow of Light is the entry gavel_heal_no_vow. Reference search 2026-11-22: ADR Sun Cleric 0004 and the four-arm scenario sun-cleric-solemn-priest-gavel-heal.json measured Arbiter alone at ratio 1 without Vow; nothing found beyond the tooltip, the DBC and that ADR.

behaviours.name: Luminary Mendicant (Arcane lockout still held 3000 ms after the cast)
behaviours.quote: and causes Horusath Blast to interrupt the target for $547217d.
behaviours.observe_source: Luminary Mendicant 547214 Effect[1] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectTriggerSpell 547217; the handler casts 547217 at the target on a Horusath Blast 500154 damage event (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:126, :322). 547217 Effect[0] 68 SPELL_EFFECT_INTERRUPT_CAST, DurationIndex 27 (3000 ms, $547217d); Spell::EffectInterruptCast stops a channel whose ChannelInterruptFlags hold CHANNEL_INTERRUPT_FLAG_INTERRUPT and PreventionType is silence, and locks that channel's school for the duration (ProhibitSpellSchool, SpellEffects.cpp:4844). The dummy channels Evocation 12051 (Arcane, SchoolMask 64, PreventionType 1, 8 s) on itself right before the cast (target_casts_before); its Arcane lockout is read with school_prohibited. Horusath Blast 572801 is a missile (Spell.dbc Speed 20.0) and Spell.cpp:2474-2476 clamps the distance to at least 5 yd and sets the delay to floor(distance / Speed x 1000), so the hit, and the lockout with it, comes floor(5 / 20 x 1000) = 250 ms after the cast with the dummy inside 5 yd (placed 3 yd away). The lockout therefore ends 250 + 3000 = 3250 ms after the cast. lockout_held reads 3000 ms after the cast: locked means a duration above 3000 - delay - 25 = 2725 ms, which excludes -10% (2700 ms). lockout_free reads 3475 ms after the cast: free means a duration below 3475 - delay + 25 = 3250 ms, which excludes +10% (3300 ms). Both exclusions hold for any delay from 200 to 275 ms, and the derived delay of 250 ms lies inside. Control arm: before the learn the same Horusath Blast 572801 is cast at the channelling dummy without 547214, no interrupt and no lockout, and the school reads 0. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 547214: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Blightbreaker (Mercy period)
behaviours.quote: Increases the tick rate of Mercy by $s1%,
behaviours.observe_source: Blightbreaker 707433 Effect[0] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME, the period of a periodic aura), BasePoints -51 + 1 = -50 ($s1 shown unsigned), and Effect[1] MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST), BasePoints 99 + 1 = 100 ($s2), both on Mercy 504848's class mask (SpellFamilyFlags[0] 32). Mercy 504848 Effect[0] aura 23 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectAmplitude 3000, ManaCostPercentage 21 of the reference base mana 1363 (286.23). The period of the Mercy aura on the caster is read after a real cast before the learn (3000, the control) and after a real cast with Blightbreaker learned: owner ruling O-24 (2026-11-22), Sun Cleric ADR 0031, reads the tooltip literally, a tick rate +$s1% = 50% with the duration unchanged, so the period is 3000 x 100 / 150 = 2000 ms (the stock -50% period modifier gave 1500 ms, a +100% rate; mentor D-74 is withdrawn). The server's aura_ascension_sun_cleric_mercy sets Mercy's amplitude before the engine applies the unchanged -50% modifier, so the aura reads 2000 while the passive's spell_modifier check keeps the DBC -500.

behaviours.name: Blightbreaker (Mercy ticks by 4.3 s)
behaviours.quote: Increases the tick rate of Mercy by $s1%,
behaviours.observe_source: Each tick of Mercy 504848 (Effect[0] aura 23 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL of Mercy Proc 503650, EffectAmplitude 3000, DurationIndex 29 = 12000 ms, CastingTimeIndex 1 = instant, SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD: one tick on apply) casts 503650 from the caster, so the caster's 503650 cast count counts the ticks. The count is read 4300 ms after a real cast of Mercy. Control = the before phase, a real cast without Blightbreaker: ticks at 0 and 3000 ms, floor(4300 / 3000) + 1 = 2 by the read. Between the phases the first Mercy runs out (expire 20000 ms, past its 12000 ms duration), so it has cast 12000 / 3000 + 1 = 5 times in all, and the count is cumulative on the same caster. After the learn the second Mercy ticks every 2000 ms (owner ruling O-24, 2026-11-22, ADR 0031: tick rate +50% = period 2000 ms, duration unchanged): floor(4300 / 2000) + 1 = 3 ticks by the read, so the expected reading is 5 + 3 = 8. The expectation is derived from the DBC period and the ruling, never from a measurement. Tolerance 0, and the two ticks reads together (mercy_ticks_early at 4300 ms, mercy_ticks_late at 5500 ms) bound the period to 1834 to 2150 ms (2000 ms is -8.3% and +7.5% inside), which excludes 1800 and 2200 ms: a period of 2200 ms (+10%) gives 2 ticks by 4300 ms, so 5 + 2 = 7; the unfixed -50% modifier (1500 ms) reads 5 + 3 = 8 at 4300 ms and 5 + 4 = 9 at 5500 ms, a period of 3000 ms (no fix) reads 5 + 2 = 7 at both. Deterministic on the simulated clock, no probability. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 503650 and 504848: 0 events in 186 logs; nothing found beyond the tooltip, the ruling and the server DBC.

behaviours.name: Empowered Holy Form (Ancient Rites first tick by 10.8 s)
behaviours.quote: Doubles the effectiveness of your Holy Form and reduces the tick rate of Ancient Rites by $/1000;s2 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: 800602 Effect[1] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 19 (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME, SpellDefines.h:95, the period of a periodic aura), BasePoints -5001 = -5000 ms ($/1000;s2 = 5 s); Ancient Rites 300351 (rank 1; the class aura script reduces the period of all three ranks, 300351, 301345 and 301817, Sun Cleric ADR 0016) Effect[0] aura 227 EffectAmplitude 15000 triggers the energize 301368, so the period is 15000 - 5000 = 10000 ms. 800602 is known from the start (learn) and Ancient Rites 300351 is the gate learned between the phases: the periodic aura is created with the modifier in place and the before phase has no Ancient Rites at all (its energize count is 0). The energize events of 301368 are counted a set time after the Holy Form cast of the second phase, which follows the gate learn by 500 ms (expire_ms) plus no cast delay (the cast is instant). Read 10300 ms after the cast, 10.8 to 10.9 s after the gate learn: exactly 1 energize, so the period is at most 10.9 s (excludes 11 s, +10%). Control entry period_control: the same two phases without 800602, 0 energize at the same time. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history and merged PRs and the bindmysoul snapshot give nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC for this value; nothing found.

behaviours.name: Blessed One (slow duration)
behaviours.quote: and reduces the duration of movement slowing effects by $s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: 680670 Effect[0] aura 232 SPELL_AURA_MECHANIC_DURATION_MOD, EffectMiscValue 11 (MECHANIC_SNARE), EffectBasePoints -21 + 1 = -20 ($s1 = 20): snare durations on the caster x0.8. Vehicle Glyph of Heart Strike 58617 (D-277: replaces Hamstring 1715, DmgClass 2 melee, which can miss, so a missed last attempt moved the read by the 500 ms retry wait): DmgClass 0, SpellFamilyName 0, its only effect Effect[0] 6 APPLY_AURA with aura 33 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DECREASE_SPEED and EffectMechanic[0] 11 on EffectImplicitTargetA 6, Speed 0, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms (SpellDuration.dbc, DurationPerLevel 0, MaxDuration 10000), no Attributes, no spell script or proc row. Unit::SpellHitResult (Unit.cpp:4231-4245) returns SPELL_MISS_NONE for a DmgClass 0 spell with a non-damage effect, so the one attempt (attempts 1) never misses; a cast that does not apply leaves no aura and reads 0, which is unmeasured before and an alert after, never a silent pass. Expected from the installed DBC and the tooltip, nothing from a run: full duration 10000 ms (DurationIndex 1) x 0.8 = 8000 ms, delta -2000 ms. margin_ms 50 (the existing duration_ratio field, as 807507, 807873 and 704581 use it): the verdict takes the expected delta from the full DBC duration, not from the measured baseline, and is void unless the before read plus its elapsed time equals 10000 ms within the margin and both phases share one landing offset within it. The margin (50 ms plus the run's tick overshoot) must stay below 10% of the 2000 ms delta (200 ms), or the verdict is unmeasured; a delta 10% off (-1800 or -2200 ms) and a duration 10% off (7200 or 8800 ms after) are therefore excluded, as is the earlier 525 ms margin that passed cuts of -15% to -25%. Control: the before phase without 680670.

behaviours.name: Solar Guardian (stun duration)
behaviours.quote: Reduces the duration of stun effects on you by $s2%.
behaviours.observe_source: 704581 Effect[1] $s2 = 20: stun durations on the caster x0.8. Vehicle Stun 2880 (installed DBC duration 10000 ms) cast once per phase (attempts 1) so the read is a single, undiminished landing: the earlier design landed it three times 500 ms apart and read a diminished re-application (1994 ms before). Expected delta = 10000 x (0.8 - 1) = -2000 ms between the landing-corrected durations (each read plus its elapsed time since the cast); margin 50 ms plus the run's tick overshoot, unmeasured unless below 10% of the expected delta (200 ms), so a 10% deviation either side is excluded. The 27 s gap between the phases exceeds the 15 s diminishing-returns reset. Control: the before phase without 704581. Expected from the installed DBC and the tooltip; nothing from a run. Reference search 2026-11-22 (G-11): ~/CoaServer/reference snapshots (ascension-data, bindmysoul, sidekick) and coa-history (186 logs); bindmysoul gives the same -20%; 0 logged events; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

Control: the before phase without the talent, same steps, full 10000 ms, held. Expected from the installed DBC and the tooltip; nothing from a run.

behaviours.name: Pendant of the Sun (charges after the refresh: nine heals leave one)
behaviours.quote: Activate your pendant of the sun, refreshing the duration and all charges of Dawn.
behaviours.observe_source: Dawn 807440 tooltip (Spell.dbc, enUS): 'Your next 10 damaging or healing spells or abilities will trigger the Fulfillment effect of your Vow. ... Each damaging or healing spell will expend a charge regardless of whether or not your current Vow is fulfilled by it.' ProcCharges 10. Illumination 500143 is a SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL (Useful, AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:57-67), each non-triggered cast of it runs SpendDawn from OnSpellBeforeEffects (:214) which does SetCharges(charges - 1), or Remove() at the last charge (:131-134); a Vow fulfilment is not needed. Two heals run in both phases (10 - 2 = 8 before). Pendant 680630 then refreshes all charges to ProcCharges 10 (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:525-531) and nine more heals spend 9: 10 - 9 = 1 charge. Dawn 807440 is a harness phase_auras fixture (the condition Pendant needs, not the subject). Design 3: Illumination 500143 has a 2000 ms cast time (SpellCastTimes 5), so a heal every 1600 ms (first pair d1: 9 casts spent 5 charges, 6 casts spent 3, the alternate casts refused while the previous one was still casting) is refused every other time; the casts are now 2200 ms apart and the charges are read 2600 ms after the last cast, once it has landed.

The Dawn state aura 807440 is set on the caster by the harness at the start of each phase (phase_auras) (a precondition fixture, the condition Pendant needs, not the subject); the setup casts of Illumination 500143 (a direct heal on the caster at 50% health) run in both phases, before the first reading, and the trigger cast is made in the after phase only. behaviours.name: Arbiter of Grace (Glorious Execution mana while Vow of Grace is active)
behaviours.quote: While Vow of Grace is active, your Glorious Execution now regenerates an additional $807446s3% mana equal to the damage dealt.
behaviours.observe_source: 301313 Arbiter of Grace Effect[0] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 3 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT1), Spell.dbc BasePoints -1, set to 14 (+1 = 15) by AscensionSunClericValkyrie.cpp:25-26, class mask word 1 = 1024 = Glorious Execution Mana Passive 807451 SpellFamilyFlags[1]; 807451 Effect[0] BasePoints 4 (+1 = 5, the base 5% of the damage dealt) is the base percent. The class code (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp, OnSpellHitResult) restores CalculatePct(dealt, Amount(807451) + Amount(807446, 2)) as 807552 for Glorious Execution 800691 and 802566 while the caster has 301313 and the Vow of Grace aura 803719, and CalculatePct(dealt, Amount(807451)) otherwise; both reads are made without a caster, so 301313's own SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 never reaches them (Sun Cleric ADR 0018, mentor D-84). Vow of Grace 807446 Effect[2] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 3 BasePoints 14 (+1 = 15, $807446s3), class mask word 2 = 16777216 = Arbiter's own SpellFamilyFlags[2]. Glorious Execution 803913 is cast at the dummy in both phases with +20000 attack power and every hit forced critical (984954) so the damage is the same to well under 1%; the energize events of 807552 are totalled. The totals are cumulative over the scenario: the first reading is X (the first phase, 5% of the damage, no 301313), the second adds the second phase's events, so the stated ratio is (X + 20%/5% X) / X = 5.0 when the passive adds 15 points to 5, and 2.0 when it adds nothing. The 15-point claim has a band of 2 points (the larger of 5% of 15 and 2), 0.4 on that ratio (2/5), so 5.0 +- 0.4 excludes 4.4 and 5.6 and the 2.0 of no additional mana. Control: the first phase without 301313. Vow of Grace 803719 is cast on the caster before each phase (setup_casts); the arm without it is the entry ge_mana_no_vow. Reference search 2026-11-22: bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries 'While Vow of Grace is active, your Glorious Execution now regenerates an additional 15% mana equal to the damage dealt.' (same figure); merged PR #4516 (#1818) set 301313's BasePoints and asserted 807451's modified value only, which no mana restore read (b6b review report I-1); coa-history shows Glorious Execution mana at 4.77% to 4.97% of its damage across 16 player/log pairs, and Arbiter of Grace, a passive, has no event there, so the logs neither confirm nor refute the 15%.

arms.source: each accepted interaction makes the ally cast 802145 on itself once, which applies its aura (802145 Effect[1] aura 77 MECHANIC_IMMUNITY), so its application on the ally is counted (AscensionSunClericSummons.cpp:106-117): 1 after the first interaction and the refused one, 2 after the accepted one

behaviours.observe_source: Code: SunGate (AscensionSunClericSummons.cpp:22-43) summons the gate 50331 at the caster's origin, then leaps the caster; npc_ascension_sun_gate::sGossipHello (:106-117) requires the interacting player alive, within INTERACTION_DISTANCE, friendly to and in a group with the owner, and without 802148, then removes impairing auras and casts 802145 (Effect[0] radius index 20 = 25 yd, $802145a1) and 802148 (DurationIndex 23 = 90000 ms, $802148d = 90 sec). The grouped ally (ally_arm) stands 3 yd from the caster's origin along x (ally_offsets), inside the 5 yd interaction distance, so the harness gossip_hello with entry 50331 does not walk it (calibration read rb7 2026-11-22, a throwaway probe, never counted: an ungrouped ally 3 yd from the gate kept its position, a grouped one moved 25.0 yd). The before phase casts Sun Gate and the ally interacts (lockout 802148 applied, count 1); the caster and the ally are moved back 25 yd along x after the blink, so the next gate stands 3 yd from the ally; 81000 ms after the first interaction (0.9 x the DBC 90000 ms) a new Sun Gate (reset_cooldown, a named precondition fixture: 802161 RecoveryTime 90000) and the ally's interaction is refused (count stays 1); 99000 ms after the first (1.1 x 90000) another gate and the interaction is accepted (count 2). The 99 s acceptance with the same geometry is the control for the 81 s refusal; a lockout of 81 s or less, or of 99 s or more, alerts. Judged reading: the ally's 802145 application count (each accepted interaction casts it once, :115), 1 then 2; the ally's 802148 count is recorded beside it and not judged (owner observation: it reads 2 then 4, a double application per accepted interaction for one cast at :116, see the ledger reason). cast_power refills the mana for each Sun Gate (27% of base mana; not a mana claim). Deterministic: no roll, residual 0 per pair. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history and the bindmysoul snapshot give nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

behaviours.quote: and stuns enemies within $a1 yds
behaviours.reach_source: the dummy entry 36 combat reach 1.275 yd (creature_model_info CombatReach of display 367, world DB; read 1.275 in the Templar 1161 aggro_redirect edge run 20261112-053731), added for a player-controlled caster against a non-player target (Spell.cpp:9434-9442); the caster's own size is not a term; the judge reads each reach again and refuses a layout that does not bracket the edge
behaviours.observe_source: 807870 Effect[0] aura 12 SPELL_AURA_MOD_STUN, TargetA 22 SRC_CASTER, TargetB 15 TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY, EffectRadiusIndex 14 = 8 yd ($a1, the tooltip resolves 8; SpellEffectInfo::CalcRadius, SpellInfo.cpp:624-639, no SPELLMOD_RADIUS here). Effective radius (guide section 5, G-29): the area search measures from the caster, centre to centre, against 8 yd + the player caster's leeway 2.66 yd (Spell.cpp:1388-1394 for TargetB 15; Object.cpp:1787-1808, LEEWAY_BONUS_RANGE for a run speed above LEEWAY_MIN_MOVE_SPEED 4.97, ObjectDefines.h:50-51, a standing player in run mode at 7.0 yd/s) + the dummy's combat reach 1.275 yd (Spell.cpp:9434-9442) = 11.935 yd, computed by the kind's leeway option from the engine rule and the caster's run speed rate read in the run (ADR 1190), not from a measured edge; earlier diagnostic reads (stunned at about 11.4 yd, not at 12.5 yd, Sun Cleric b7a review I4) agree. The leeway is this core's inherited rule, not evidence about the original server. The primary dummy stands 0.1 yd from the caster and the inside and outside dummies 0.5 yd either side of 11.935 yd. Control arm: the cast is refused before 807870 is learned (gate = cast spell, learned between the arms), no stun on any dummy; treatment: one cast after the learn (120 s cooldown, so one repeat), the stun read per dummy: on the primary and the inside dummy, not on the outside one. behaviours.name: Sun Down (attackers swing inside the scorched earth)
behaviours.quote: reduces the target's chance to hit by
behaviours.observe_source: Solar Flare 807175 Effect[0] aura 54 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HIT_CHANCE BasePoints -3 ($s1 = 3), DurationIndex 10000 ms ($d), applied every 3000 ms by the ground aura 572754 of Sun Down 572752 (CastingTimeIndex 5 = 2000 ms, ground 9000 ms starting 4000 ms after the cast starts). Eight aggressive stationary attackers (Harvest Golem 36, class level) melee the caster; the control arm counts their swings and misses with no cast, the treatment arm recasts Sun Down every 8000 ms (reset_cooldown and set_power are named precondition fixtures, G-21 point 6) and counts after 13000 ms, once the aura from the caster is read on every attacker; the aura is read on every attacker at each cycle end. Expected: the miss share rises by 3 points (the stated 3% of the DBC amount, never from a run); the judge takes the 99% interval of the difference of the two shares against the band of 2 points (the larger of 5% of 3 and 2), a verdict needing a half-width of at most half the band, so a correct server fails by chance with probability under 1e-6 and one 3 points off is excluded. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 572752/572753/572754/807175: Sun Down in one log (2026-08-01, 7 casts, no combat-table data on the attackers' swings); the bindmysoul snapshot carries the same sentence; nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Sun Shield (attackers' spells hit 3 points less often)
behaviours.quote: Reduces your chance to be hit by spells by
behaviours.observe_source: 300348 Effect[0] aura 186 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_SPELL_HIT_CHANCE (EffectApplyAuraName[0] 186), EffectBasePoints[0] -4 + EffectDieSides[0] 1 = -3 points (server DBC set /srv/coa/server-data/dbc, read rb7 2026-11-22; the expected 3 is this value, never a run), EffectMiscValue[0] 126 (every magic school, Holy included), so an attacker's spell hit chance against the caster drops by 3 points (the DBC amount, never from a run). Path: Unit::MagicSpellHitResult (Unit.cpp:3951-4049): modHitChance = 96 - levelDiff for levelDiff < 3, plus the victim's aura 186 total for the school, HitChance = modHitChance x 100 plus the attacker's m_modSpellHitChance x 100 (the creature fixture spell_hit_bonus), clamped to [100, 10000], a miss when irand(1, 10000) < 10000 - HitChance. Four stationary Harvest Golems 36 at the class level (levelDiff 0, base 96%) cast Smite 585 (Holy, magic damage class, the harness creature cast with TRIGGERED_FULL_MASK; calibration read rb7 2026-11-22, a throwaway probe never counted: a level 50 attacker missed 6 of 30 such casts, so the triggered creature cast rolls hit) at the caster 826 times each: control (300348 not learned) at hit bonus 4 (100%: no miss) and 3 (99%: at least one miss), treatment (300348 learned, its aura read) at 7 (100% with the 3-point reduction) and 6 (99%). The control arms fix the base at 96 (else unmeasured); the treatment arms then fix the reduction at exactly 3 points, so 2 and 4 are excluded (+-33%). Misses = SPELL_GO count less damage logs, and every arm must read its 826 casts (else unmeasured). Residual: an edge arm without a miss on a correct server 0.99^826 = 2.5e-4 per arm and run, at most 1.0e-3 per pair over the four edge readings. A refused creature cast fails its step, so the run is missing readings and unmeasured (the kind's equivalent of void_on_cast_failure, a metric_delta option). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 300348: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); the bindmysoul and sidekick snapshots under ~/CoaServer/reference carry the tooltip words only; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC for the value.

The caster's mana is set to 82 before each phase's casts (regeneration off): the before phase cannot pay 340 and casts 0 times; the after phase pays 81 for the Sun Ray, keeps 1, and Radiant Flame goes through (1 cast of 806060 by the caster) only if its cost is at most 1 mana: a cost of 2 or more fails, so a 90% reduction (34 mana), a 99% one (3 mana) and any other short of 100% are excluded. Scorch Marks is granted by a real Sun Ray 504764 cast (setup_casts, the harness learns Sun Ray), never by set_aura; 704908 is known throughout and the before phase, without the Sun Ray, is the control. The same shape as the Searing Light 806021 entries of the same pair family (Scorch Marks 807059 Effect[0] aura 108 SPELLMOD op 1 -51 (-50), Effect[1] op 19 -51 (-50), Effect[2] op 14 -101 (-100), class mask 134217728 = Radiant Flame 806060: DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms, EffectAmplitude 1000, ManaCostPercentage 25 of base mana 1363 = 340). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spells 806060 Radiant Flame, 807058 and 504764 Sun Ray: 0 events in 186 logs; spell 807059 Scorch Marks: 296 applications and 296 removals in 7 logs, no value to read; bindmysoul 806021 and 804625 texts read the Scorch Marks sentence as ours ("no mana cost, ticks -50% faster, duration reduced by -50%"); nothing else found. behaviours.name: Scroll of Hope (Magic damage taken 30% less)
behaviours.quote: Read from a scroll of hope, reducing Magic damage taken by party and raid members within $a1 yds by $s1% for $d.
behaviours.observe_source: 680646 Scroll of Hope Effect[0] APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID TargetA 1 (caster), aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN MiscValue 126 (the six magic schools), BasePoints -31 (-30 percent, $s1), radius index 18 (15 yd, $a1), DurationIndex 1 (10000 ms, $d); Effect[1] APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 681383; 681383 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_HEAL_PCT BasePoints 14 (+1 = 15 percent, $681383s1) on the caster-side target. Code (Sun Cleric ADR 0040, owner ruling O-29): AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:79-81 accepts a received damaging hit that takes the aura's holder from at least 35% to below 35% of its maximum health (a fall; health before the hit = health after + damage), :299-302 has the holder cast 681383 on itself with the Cleric as original caster, so the heal lands on the unit that fell, once per fall. The Scroll is cast for real in the after phase only (cast_in_before false; 680646 has a 300000 ms cooldown, reset before the cast); the before phase is the control: the same strike without the Scroll. Strikes come from the passive striker (creature 36, spell hit bonus 100) with Grave Coil 47632 (Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE, Shadow, BasePoints 599 + 1 die side = 600, DmgClass magic, one hit, no tick), 1600 ms after the Scroll. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spells 680646, 681383 and 47632: 0 events in 186 logs; ~/CoaServer/reference/snapshots/bindmysoul talents.normalized.json reads "reducing Magic damage taken by party and raid members within 15 yds by -30% for 10 seconds ... below 35% ... healed once for 15%" (agrees with the DBC); nothing else found. Reduction: the cumulative amount Grave Coil dealt to the caster is read after each phase, c in the before phase (no Scroll) and c + h after the Scroll (one more hit h). The control hit measured 605 and 606 in the counted pair, not the 600 of the DBC base; the extra 5 to 6 is not explained and its cause is not established. The verdict therefore judges the gain against the measured control hit, as the ratio (c + h) / c = 1 + h / c = 2 - r, expected 1.70 for r = 30% with tolerance 0.02 (the 2-point band of 28% to 32% is 1.68 to 1.72): a 33% reduction reads 1.67 and a 27% reduction 1.73, both outside, and a control hit below 600 fails the floor. Scope: Shadow only (Grave Coil is Shadow); MiscValue 126 covers the six schools, and no other school and no physical control is read here. Phase aura 823764 "beeg spellpen" (Effect[0] aura 123 MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE, BasePoints -9999, MiscValue 126, DBC) is the class's standing resistance fixture, set on the caster in both phases: it lowers the resistance of what the caster hits, not the resistance the caster has against Grave Coil, so it does not touch the hits read here, and a resisted hit could only lower a reading. Read timing (rc2): the enemy strike 47632 (Speed 24) lands 5/24 = 208 ms after its cast; the read after the strike moves from 300 to 400 ms (margin 192 ms).

behaviours.name: Mercy (the cap: six receive it out of eight players)
behaviours.quote: Grant mercy to an ally and up to 5 nearby allies,

arms.source: Mercy 504848 Effect[0] target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, EffectChainTarget 6 (the target and up to 5 more): of the seven units other than the target (the caster and ally2..ally7) exactly 5 hold the aura, whichever the chain picks; none holds it in the uncast control. Uncapped it would be 6.
arms.reach_source: The unit filter of the chain search is TARGET_CHECK_ALLY: WorldObjectSpellTargetCheck keeps a unit when _IsValidAssistTarget holds, with no IsInPartyWith or IsInRaidWith test (Spell.cpp:9353-9358, reached through WorldObjectSpellAreaTargetCheck with the Chain reason, :9420-9479, which adds only a distance test; only TARGET_CHECK_PARTY :9359 and TARGET_CHECK_RAID :9373 test the group), so ally5 in raid subgroup 2 stands within the 10 yd hop like the party members. Mercy 504848 Effect[0] target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY with EffectChainTarget[0] 6: Spell::SelectImplicitTargetObjectTargets adds the explicit ally and calls Spell::SelectImplicitChainTargets (Spell.cpp:1895-1917, :1919-1939), which asks SearchChainTargets for ChainTarget - 1 = 5 more units (Spell.cpp:2200-2300); the spell is a magic-class spell, so the search radius is the 10 yd jump radius times 5 and each hop is within 10 yd of the previous unit; no spell_jump_distance row and no script for 504848 or 503650 exists (data/sql searched), and Mercy MaxAffectedTargets 6 is read only for cone and area targets (Spell.cpp:1303, :1405)

behaviours.observe_source: 504848 Mercy Effect[0] target 21 TARGET_UNIT_TARGET_ALLY, EffectChainTarget[0] 6: the explicit ally plus ChainTarget - 1 = 5 more units (Spell.cpp:1895-1939, SearchChainTargets :2200-2300; reach_source on the arm). Mercy is cast at ally with six other players (the caster and ally2..ally7, all within the 10 yd hop): the aura is read on the target (1) and summed over the six others, the caster and ally2..ally7 (5, the cap of the tooltip "up to 5 nearby allies"); 0 in the uncast control before. Uncapped, the six others would all read 1 (6, and 7 with the target), so a cap of 6 or more would read 6 on the others. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history and the bindmysoul snapshot give nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC for the count; nothing found.

behaviours.quote: Increases the spell haste of all party and raid members by $s1% and your spell haste by an additional $s2%.
behaviours.observe_source: 804257 Glaring Rays Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID aura 216 SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS, BasePoints 2 + 1 = 3 ($s1), TargetA 1 (caster), radius index 287; Effect[1] APPLY_AURA aura 216, BasePoints 2 + 1 = 3 ($s2), TargetA 1. Holy Form 805301 is cast in both phases as the trigger and the passive is learned between them (control: the before reading without it, multiplier 1). The unit's engine cast speed multiplier (the same function as the Swift Justice 300327 spell_haste entry) is read 1500 ms after. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 804257: 0 events (a passive leaves no event); nothing else found beyond the tooltip and the DBC. The caster receives both effects. Each aura 216 multiplies the unit's cast speed: AuraEffect::HandleModCastingSpeed (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5035-5056) calls Unit::ApplyCastTimePercentMod (Unit.cpp:14991-14999) once per effect, and ApplyPercentModFloatVar multiplies by 100 / (100 + 3) (Unit.cpp:14967-14970), so the two effects give 1 / (1.03 x 1.03) = 0.942596, not the additive 1 / 1.06 = 0.943396 (pair 1 read 0.942596 in both runs; this expectation is the engine rule, written from the code before the re-run). The second effect applies only through the CoA raid group exception (SpellMgr.cpp:826-828, 4ced460235): Glaring Rays is in spell_group 2000182, which the stock rule (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:5049-5051) would let block Effect[1]. Mentor ruling D-119 (2026-11-22): the second effect 'an additional $s2%' is its own aura 216, so the engine stacks the two multipliers: 1/1.03^2 for the caster, 1/1.03 for a party ally (ally_haste). The tooltip's additive reading, 1/1.06 = 0.943396, differs by 0.08%, eight times the tolerance of this band, which accepts only the engine value; the expectation is the engine rule with its cited lines, not the measured value.

behaviours.name: Gleaming Vigil (Physical damage taken at 74% health, the base 5% only)
behaviours.quote: Reduces your Physical damage taken by $s1%,
behaviours.observe_source: 704585 Gleaming Vigil Effect[0] aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN MiscValue 1 (Physical), BasePoints -6 (-5 as read, $s1); Effect[1] aura 23 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL 707769 every 500 ms (aura 87 MiscValue 1, BasePoints -6, -5, $s2), the helper aura kept on the caster only while it is above 80% health (the Gleaming Armor 805267 pattern). Void Zone 92559 (1000 Physical direct damage, no cooldown, no cost) strikes the caster in a control arm (passive unlearned) and in an arm with 704585 learned; the caster health is set to 74% (below) or 82% (above) before every trial (the helper aura 707769 is checked absent at 74% and present at 82%). The server keeps the helper through a 75% to 80% hysteresis band by design (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:366-370, b2ad6f76d6, #5763 and #5783: enter above 80%, leave at or below 75%), so 74% is the nearest arm outside the band; the literal 80% itself is not pinned by these arms. The two aura 87 effects multiply, so the expected ratio at 82% is 0.95 x 0.95 = 0.9025, not their sum; the ratio of the damage taken is judged against the stated value. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 704585 has no cast event (a passive); nothing found beyond the tooltip and Spell.dbc.

behaviours.observe_source: 300723 Effect[2] is rewritten at load to aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, 30 (the $s3), MiscValue Holy|Fire (AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp:185-186), reading 3 of the three readings below. Justicar's Wrath 806980 (Holy) is read as its existing damage entry reads it (unmodified 531..541 at the reference stats, dummy Holy resistance removed by 823764). The hit is read after a real learn of 300723: 531..541 x 1.30 = 690..703, inside [689, 705], which lies within the 2-point band (28% to 32%: 680..714) and excludes +25% (664..676) and +35% (717..730). HELD, uncertain expectation sent to the mentor: the value has three readings and no source picks one. (1) Tooltip text with ruling G-13 ('spell damage' names the spell power stat): spell power x 1.30, which adds 0 at the reference spell power 0 and +3000 at a 10000 spell power fixture (Justicar's Wrath 806980, spell power coefficient 0.55: +1650 on 6036, +27%). (2) DBC 300723 Effect[2] aura 174 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_DAMAGE_OF_STAT_PERCENT, BasePoints 29 (+1 = 30), MiscValue 6 (Holy|Fire), MiscValueB 3 (Intellect): 30% of the reference Intellect 119 = 35.7 spell power (x 0.55 = +19.6 on the 536 hit, +3.7%). (3) Server rewrite at load: AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp:185-186 replaces Effect[2] with aura 79 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE, 30, Holy|Fire (commit e36bc50aad, which gives no source): 536 x 1.30 = 696.8 (+160.8, +30%). This arm measures reading 3 only, so it shows what the server does, not what the tooltip or the DBC say. Reference search 2026-11-22 (guide section 4): bindmysoul, coabuildhub and ascension-data carry the same tooltip text and none states a damage percent or a share of Intellect; nothing found for the value. Residual failure probability of a correct server per pair: not quantified. A crit roll reads 0 under fields critical false and alerts (a false alert, never a false pass); the caster's Holy crit chance at the reference stats is not read, and adding the spell crit fixture 984954 made the read 0 in both runs of the first fix pair (cause not investigated), so it is not used. spell_hit_rating is 10000 in the class ratings; the hit 515..523 plus 17 attack power, x 1.30, lies in 690..703 by arithmetic, inside [689, 705]. Fixture 984954 on the caster in both phases (DBC: effect 1 aura 57 SPELL_AURA_MOD_SPELL_CRIT_CHANCE, -1001, a precondition fixture, never the subject) removes the natural crit chance, so the first phase (talent not learned, the control) heals without a crit and any crit after the learn comes from the guarantee. Radiant Cascade 500141 is cast at the ally in both phases (CastingTimeIndex 19 = 2500 ms, read after 3000 ms); the second target of its chain heal is the caster and is not read. Bless 804247 is cast at the grouped ally in both phases (a real cast). Critical heals on the ally: 0 before the learn (control) and 1 after it; non-critical heals: 1 before and still 1 after. A heal that is not a guarantee would read 0 critical after the learn. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 707517: 0 events (a passive leaves no event); the tooltip and the DBC carry the sentence, nothing else found.

Solar Concord 301266 is learned at the start of both phases and cast for real in the second phase only (setup_only_after); the first phase, with Rapture 807372 alone, is the control. Solar Flare 807175 Effect[1] SCHOOL_DAMAGE, BasePoints 50 (+1), RealPointsPerLevel 1.9, DieSides 1: $m2+$ppl2 = 136.5 at the reference level and spell power 0 (the tooltip reading of the reference character). Rapture has a 3000 ms cast time (CastingTimeIndex 14), so the read waits 4000 ms after the cast. Rapture and Sunset are the second path of the clause 'their damage dealt'. Reference search 2026-11-22: bindmysoul snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) repeats the Solar Concord tooltip; nothing else found.

behaviours.observe_source: 681337 Holy Giant Effect[0] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), BasePoints 99 + 1 = +100%, EffectSpellClassMask word 2 = 537919488, which holds 536870912 = the SpellFamilyFlags[2] of Vow of Light 807750 (Effect[0] BasePoints 9 + 1 = 10, the percent of the damage or healing received that the copy heal 505197 returns, AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:236-243). The script reads Amount(807750, 0, caster), so the modifier reaches it once. Vow of Light 807547 is cast on the caster in both phases; Light of the Naaru 41394 (BasePoints 1099 + 1 = 1100 Holy) hits the caster (50% health) and the copy heal 505197 is read. spell_heal_total sums every heal event since the scenario started, so the second reading carries the first: (H + 2H) / H = 3.0 when the value is doubled (H = 10% of 1100 = 110), 2.0 when it is not, 4.0 when tripled. The band is 5 points of +100% (G-19), 0.05 on the ratio: 3.0 +- 0.05 excludes 2.95 and 3.05 and with them the 2.0 of no doubling. Control: the phase before the learn of 681337. Crit forced out by 984954. The Vow of the Valkyr half is the valkyr_damage entry. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 681337: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); the same effect on Soul of Light 807964 and Sunwalker 704934 reads 110 and 330 in the b10 base pair; nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Valkyr's Calling (charge-back bracket around the 2 s duration)
behaviours.quote: At the end of the duration, you charge back down, dealing ${$570034m1+$570034ppl1+$AP*1+$SP*.225} Holy damage to all enemies within $570034a1 yds.
behaviours.observe_source: Charge-back time bracket: Spell.dbc 520025 duration 2000 ms (the aura of 520024), the landing cast 570034 comes with its end. One cast of 520024 at the dummy with the dummy selected (the landing no longer reads the selection, Sun Cleric ADR 0043; charge_hit_unselected reads it without one); 570034 damage to the dummy read at 1800 to 1950 ms of game time after the cast (before the end of $d, expected 0, the 10% margin 200 ms excluded) and at 2050 to 2200 ms (after it, expected 497.6, the DBC figure of the counted charge_hit entry, 570034 at the reference stats). The windows exclude a value 10% off the 2000 ms on both sides. Control: the no-cast first phase reads 0. Landing time. Code (AscensionSunClericSummons.cpp:44-95): a scheduler task fires when the flight aura 520025 ends, calls MoveCharge at speed 50 toward the target, re-checks every 50 ms until the movespline is finalized and then casts 570034; the dummy stands 3 yd from the caster. Measured 2026-11-23 on four runs of probe copies of this entry: damage 0 at 2128 ms and 497 at 2168 ms after the cast, so the landing lies in (2128, 2168] ms, within 40 ms of this entry's 2168 ms read; the entry read 497 in three runs and 0 in one loaded 15-lane run (base14 run 2). The caster is therefore moved dx 2.5 along x before the cast (relocate_before_trigger, a precondition fixture: 0.5 yd from the dummy, 10 ms of travel at speed 50): four probe runs read 0 at 2031 ms and 497 at 2081 ms, the landing lies in (2031, 2081] ms, at least 87 ms before the 2168 ms read, which a loaded run would need to delay by more than one 50 ms re-check to miss. Report .agents/plans/fl/report.md. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 570034 and 520024 give no timing of the landing; nothing found.

behaviours.observe_source: 520024 Valkyr's Calling Effect[1] triggers 520025 on the caster, whose Effect[2] is aura 39 SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_IMMUNITY MiscValue 127 (all seven schools), DurationIndex 39 = 2000 ms ($d). 47632 (600 Shadow, DmgClass 1, school mask 32 Shadow) is cast at the caster by a creature striker. Read timing (rc2): the enemy strike 47632 (Speed 24) lands 5/24 = 208 ms after its cast; the read after the strike moves from 300 to 400 ms (margin 192 ms).

behaviours.name: Blessing of Absolution (additional threat, Blessed ally)
behaviours.quote: Empower a Blessed ally to unleash a burst of holy energy in front of them, dealing ${$m1+0+$BH*1.5} Holy damage enemies in a $804252a1 yd frontal cone and generating additional threat.

ally_casts.source: Bless 804247 cast at the ally also blesses the caster (AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:67-74, id == Bless && target != player casts Bless on the caster): two SPELL_GO events per cast, counted in the harness proof

behaviours.observe_source: 804252 Blessing of Absolution Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_THREAT BasePoints 14 + 1 = 15, the additional threat of the tooltip ('generating additional threat'; no number). CoA's Spell.dbc carries these effect 63 values as a percentage of the damage, which Ascension used and the server reproduces with a spell_threat row of pctMod 1 + 15 / 100 = 1.15 (data/sql/updates/pending_db_world/rev_20261026_20_coa_tank_ability_threat.sql, merged in PR #9382 for the other effect 63 spells; the High Threat ruling for Justicar's Wrath 806980 (threat x2) concerns another tooltip word and does not decide 'additional threat'; the flat effect 63 amount is kept). Threat of one hit is damage x 1.15 plus the flat effect amount 15, divided by the health the dummy lost: 1.15 + 15 / D. The cast is the 503505 cast at a Blessed ally (Bless 804247 cast at the ally in both phases), with 20000 spell power (fixture) so the Holy hit is 404..456 + int(1.5 x 20000) = 30404..30456 and the flat part moves the ratio by 0.0005 only: 1.1505. The band is 2 points of the 15 percent (G-19), 0.02: it excludes no additional threat (1.0, 1.0000 + the spell level 1 of 804252 over D) and a percentage of 13 or 17. The control of the claim is the threat_control entry of the same pair: an ordinary Holy hit reads about 1.0. Crit forced out by fixture 984954. Control (before): the same Bless without the 503505 cast, no damage and a ratio of 0. The tooltip gives no number: the qualitative claim 'additional threat' is proven by 1.1505 against the control 1.0056 (band 0.02); the 15 percent is the server convention (#9382), pinned here as a regression, not a ruling on the tooltip. Information for the mentor: the damage and the threat are credited to the Sun Cleric, not to the Blessed ally who 'unleashes' the burst. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 804252: 8 SPELL_DAMAGE events of 1015 in 1 log, no threat events are logged; the pending SQL above; nothing else found.

The Dawn state aura is set on the caster by the harness at the start of each phase (phase_auras, a precondition fixture, the condition Pendant needs, not the subject). behaviours.name: Battle Cleric (Gavel effectiveness under Paragon)
behaviours.quote: causing them to have no cooldown and have $562316s1% increased effectiveness.
behaviours.expected_source: Owner ruling O-18 (Q-sc-8, option b) with mentor decision D-146, Sun Cleric ADR 0029: the Gavel effectiveness talents apply their figure to the whole hit. The expectation is the model's prediction, committed before any arm of the fix ran (out-of-sample, never fitted to a measurement): the server sets SpellInfo::AscensionFlatAfterWeaponPercent on every Gavel rank (AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp, ApplyContracts), so Spell::EffectWeaponDmg applies the weapon percent to the weapon roll alone and then adds the flat value (SpellEffects.cpp:4724-4742). With the talents' percents summed to m (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS percent modifiers add, Player.cpp:10622), the hit is int(W x int(100 x m) / 100) + int(F x m), enumerated over every weapon roll W (urand(uint32(min), uint32(max)) with min and max = weapon damage + attack power / 14 x normalized speed, Unit.cpp:3621, StatSystem.cpp:728) and every flat roll F (BasePoints + irand(1, DieSides) from the DBC), float32 where the code uses float, then target armor: tmp = x / (1 + x) with x = armor / (85 x 60 + 400), hit = uint32(ceil(damage x (1 - tmp))) (Unit.cpp:2550-2560); non-critical hits. The gap to the displayed figure is integer truncation, under one point. Control arm: the talent not learned; its hit is the same before and after the fix (W x 100% + F = (W + F) x 100%). Band: G-19, the larger of 5% of the bonus and 2 points, not widened. Model: .agents/plans/o18/scratch/size.py (from the approved design's o18_expect.py, whose stock side reproduces the committed ADR 0008 and Glorious Defender ratios exactly). Weapon: the class file maps 300347 to the weapon set Blessings, Truncheon 2524 in the main hand (34.61 to 55.4, normalized speed 2.4). 300347 Battle Cleric applies its helper 562316 under Paragon: Effect[0] aura 108 SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS) BasePoints 49 + 1 = +50% ($562316s1) on the Gavels' mask, m = 1.5. Both arms cast Paragon 680639 before every observed cast (cooldown reset by the harness), so both run at attack power 86 (Paragon's Strength 48, q-sc-8 analysis), weapon rolls 49..70, dummy armor 528. Gavel of Wrath rank 5 802561, flat 222 + irand(1, 50): mean non-critical hit 280.6082 without the passive and 420.2109 with it, ratio 1.49750 (+49.75%). Before the fix (stock compounding): predicted 2.10060, base pair 10 (20261122-113024 / -115522, build fd0671597bc3) read +111.96 / +111.20, alert against the stated 1.5. Sizing: the model's per-hit variances give 793 trials per arm at 0.8 of the power limit; the entry pools 13 parts of 80 trials (1040 per arm).
behaviours.observe_source: Gavel of Wrath 802561 damage read in two arms of one scenario, both after a real Paragon 680639 cast; the treatment arm learns 300347 first so the script's helper 562316 is applied. Control arm: Paragon without the passive. Reference search 2026-11-22: server DBC 300347, 562316, 680639 and 802561 effects; AscensionSunClericBattleCleric.cpp; coa-history, merged PRs and ascension-data: see the report; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.
