Chance() rolls only while the caster holds 804629 (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:199), so 804629 is unlearned at the stop (no later tick of the running channel may refresh 807299) and relearned 4500 ms later, once the channel is over, so the talent is known when Dawnsear is cast; 807299 is read present after the unlearn and its application count unchanged up to the judged cast. Judged reads (mentor D-234): the Dawnsear cast itself 300 ms after it starts: 6 held trials at 9300 ms after the stop (age 9300 to 9325 ms, inside 9000 to 9650, -10% excluded) are instant (casting 0), 6 gone trials at 10700 ms (age 10700 to 10725, inside 10400 to 11000, +10% excluded) are a normal cast (casting 1); each cast must go off; at least 5 judged trials per side (mentor D-227, fixed before the run), fewer is unmeasured. behaviours.name: Radiant Halberd (a direct Physical hit cuts the cooldown of Champion of the Sun by 1 s)
behaviours.quote: Direct Physical damage dealt now reduces the cooldown of Champion of the Sun by $/1000;681263s1 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: 681252 Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 681263; 681263 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN MiscValue 800612, BasePoints -1001 + 1 = -1000 ms ($/1000;681263s1 = 1 s). Script: AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:122 accepts a damage event that is direct with SchoolMask NORMAL, :289 reduces 800612 by abs(Amount(681263)). Champion of the Sun 800612 has RecoveryTime 120000 ms (SchoolMask 1, ManaCostPercentage 25, Category 770; the cost did not block the cast in the arms). Route: Champion is cast as the primer in each arm; 1600 ms later one Gavel of Wrath 800617 (SchoolMask 1 Physical, melee weapon strike, the same hit as the wrath_extra entries) is cast at the dummy; Champion is attempted again 119080 ms (without, with: 1000 ms cut plus 80 ms) or 118920 ms (beyond: 1000 ms cut less 80 ms) after the primer. Without 681252 the 120000 ms cooldown runs on and the attempt is refused (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY); with it the cooldown ends at 119000 ms, so the 119080 ms attempt goes through and the 118920 ms attempt is refused. A cut of 900 ms ends at 119100 ms and fails the with arm; a cut of 1100 ms ends at 118900 ms and lets the beyond arm through, so +-10% on both sides is excluded. The Gavel lands: hit and expertise ratings of the class file exclude a miss, dodge or parry, and the with arm going through proves the hit was dealt (a missed Gavel leaves the 120000 ms cooldown). The class-file weapon set of the spell is Valkyr (681252 / 800612). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 681252 and 800612, git log origin/main --grep 681252, merged PRs: nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC (see the report).

behaviours.name: New Day (Judgement Day cooldown reset)
behaviours.quote: Start anew, reseting the cooldown of Paragon, Chosen of the Light, and Judgement Day spells.
behaviours.observe_source: New Day 800600 Effect[0..2] SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN (195) on 680639 Paragon, 800622 Chosen of the Light and 806121 Judgement Day. Cooldown cost_gate (resets), second design for the claim: the spell is cast as the priming cast, New Day 1600 ms later in the with arm only (without it the arm makes no after cast), then the spell is attempted again 3200 ms after the priming cast, inside its 60000 ms cooldown: refused without 800600 (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY 67, the event proves the primer started the cooldown), accepted with it. The accepted or refused cast is an event (cast_failure), not a cooldown readback. Judgement Day 806121 (RecoveryTime 60000 ms, StartRecoveryTime 1500, TargetA 22 caster area, TargetB 15 enemies, Effect[0] 183): the earlier metric_delta arm (withdrawn, b10c4) read cooldown 0 in its control because the primer cast at the caster found no enemy in the area; here the dummy stands within the area, and a refusal without 800600 other than 67 (for example no valid target) alerts. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history, merged PRs and the bindmysoul snapshot give nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC for this value; nothing found.

behaviours.quote: Damage dealt by Horusath Blast now grants you Light of Absolution for $807523d.
behaviours.name: Lights of Absolution (Light of Absolution is held to 9.6 s and gone by 10.7 s)
behaviours.observe_source: 807523 Light of Absolution DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms ($807523d), granted to the caster when a damaging Horusath Blast 572801 hit lands (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:125 and :298); the aura starts at the hit, 100 to 450 ms after the cast (dummy 5 yd away, missile speed 20 yd/s). One real Horusath Blast with 807343 learned: the aura is present when read 9500..9800 ms after the cast (game time) and gone when read 10700..11000 ms after it. The aura started at the hit, at most 450 ms after the cast, so a present read at 9500 or later excludes a duration of 9000 (10% under 10000) and a gone read at 11000 or earlier, with a hit at least 100 ms after the cast, excludes 11000 (10% over). A true duration of 10000 ends between 10100 and 10450 ms after the cast, inside neither window. Control: the without-passive phase of light_granted reads 0 for the same cast. Reference search 2026-11-22: bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries 'grants you Light of Absolution for 10 seconds'; coa-history and merged PRs give nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC for this value.

Route: Judgement Day is cast and attempted again 45700 ms after the cast (15000 ms less than its cooldown plus 700 ms): refused without the passive (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY 67, the control arm), accepted with it, and refused again 44300 ms after the cast (beyond), so the cut lies in [14300, 15700] ms, which excludes 13500 and 16500 ms (10% off on both sides). The readback entry judgement_day_cooldown stays as data; this route is the behaviour proof that a cast is refused then accepted around the reduced cooldown. behaviours.name: The Coming Dawn (Solar Concord cooldown cut by Radiant Flame under Dawn)
behaviours.quote: While Dawn is active, damage dealt by Radiant Flame now reduces the cooldown of Dawnfall and Solar Concord by $/1000;560860S1 sec.

cast_auras.reason: Dawn 804584 activates only with 20 Solar Power (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:86, AscensionSunCleric.cpp:265); 500149 is set at 20 stacks on the caster before each Dawn cast, a precondition fixture, the claim is the cooldown cut Radiant Flame damage applies while Dawn is active.

Sunrise 500477 and the Sunrise-or-Sunset checker 500643 (CasterAuraSpell of 301266) are set on the caster before each Solar Concord cast: named precondition fixtures; the claim measured is the cooldown cut Radiant Flame damage applies, not the phase condition.

behaviours.observe_source: 560861 The Coming Dawn Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 560860 (Effect[0] and Effect[1] SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_MODIFY_COOLDOWN 165, BasePoints -1001, so 1000 ms each, $/1000;560860S1 = 1 sec, MiscValue 806118 Dawnfall and 301266 Solar Concord). The class code (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:116, :263-272) reduces both cooldowns by 1000 ms on every own damage hit of Radiant Flame's tick 807058 while Dawn 807440 is on the caster. Radiant Flame 806060 lasts 4000 ms with EffectAmplitude 1000 and SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD (AttributesEx5 0x200), so one cast ticks 807058 five times (4000 / 1000 + 1, as the flame_hits entry of 806024 derives and measures), 5 x 1000 = 5000 ms in all. Route: Solar Concord 301266 (30000 ms cooldown, Spell.dbc RecoveryTime) is cast, Radiant Flame is cast at the dummy 1600 ms later with Dawn up (Dawn 804584 cast for real as the setup cast, Solar Power fixture 500149), and Solar Concord 301266 is attempted again 25250 ms after its cast (25000 ms plus 250 ms): refused without the passive (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY 67, the control arm), accepted with it, refused again at 24750 ms (beyond), so the five-tick cut lies in [4750, 5250] ms, which excludes 4500 and 5500 ms (10% off on both sides). The unset arm keeps the passive learned and skips the Dawn setup cast: Radiant Flame ticks without Dawn and the attempt is refused, the control of the clause 'While Dawn is active'. Each arm waits 40000 ms more before it starts (arm_wait_ms): the arms of this 30000 ms cooldown would otherwise be about 27000 ms apart, and a Dawn cast over a Dawn still up (807440 lasts 60000 ms) switches it off, which a first exploratory run measured (807440 read 0 after the second Dawn cast, the cut missing in the with arm); at 67000 ms between arms the Dawn of the earlier arm is gone before the next one. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 560861: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

behaviours.name: Devoted to the Light (Resplendence cost read at use time)
behaviours.quote: Removes the cost of your Solar Invocation spells and they now generate $504679s1% of your missing mana when cast.
behaviours.observe_source: 681436 Devoted to the Light Effect[0] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER misc 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) BasePoints -101 + 1 = -100% with EffectSpellClassMask[0..2] = 262144 / 128 / 524288 (the SpellFamilyFlags of Solar Invocation: Resplendence 806159 and Revelation 503651 in word 0, Ascension 500152 in word 1, Conquest 800764 in word 2). The cost is read by the engine's own use-time function, SpellInfo::CalcPowerCost of the caster (ADR 1194, use_time_contrast), with the passive learned between the phases: the learned read minus the unlearned read is the gain. Costs are ManaCostPercentage of the base mana 1363 (player_class_stats class 27 level 60, Spell.dbc). Arms of this clause, all in the same pair: cost_use_resplendence, cost_use_revelation, cost_use_conquest, cost_use_ascension (each gains minus its whole cost) and cost_use_control (Dawnsear 554406, outside the class mask, gain 0). The clause is not the plain use-time sentence, so the zero arm is required. The consumption of a charge is not a claim of this passive (no charges). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 681436: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); bindmysoul snapshot not consulted for a value; nothing else found. This arm: Resplendence 806159 costs 19% of 1363 = 258.97; the read is 258.97 before and 0 after, gain -258.97, band 1 (the engine truncates the cost to a whole number).

behaviours.name: Blessing of Absolution (10 yd cone: a dummy at 9.5 yd from the ally's edge is hit, one at 10.5 yd is not)
behaviours.quote: Empower a Blessed ally to unleash a burst of holy energy in front of them, dealing ${$m1+0+$BH*1.5} Holy damage enemies in a $804252a1 yd frontal cone and generating additional threat.

ally_casts.source: Bless 804247 cast at the ally also blesses the caster (AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:67-74, id == Bless && target != player casts Bless on the caster): two SPELL_GO events per cast, counted in the harness proof

behaviours.observe_source: 503505 Blessing of Absolution Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_TRIGGER_SPELL_WITH_VALUE (680893, then 804252); 804252 Effect[0] TARGET_UNIT_CONE_ENEMY_104 with EffectRadiusIndex 13 = 10 yd ($804252a1); script (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:495-508): with Bless 804247 on the ally, 804252 Holy damage 404..456 (m1 at level 60, spell power read 0 at the reference character) to every attackable enemy within the radius of the ally and HasInArc(pi) of the ally, the front half. Bless is cast at the ally in both phases (ally_casts), the 503505 cast at the ally is the trigger, crit forced out by fixture 984954, the read adds the resisted amount back. The ally stands at the caster's spawn, facing as the caster; dummies stand in front of the caster at the stated distance. The script's area test is Nearby(ally, 10) = Acore::AnyUnitInObjectRangeCheck, WorldObject::IsWithinDist, which adds the object sizes (combat reaches) of both units, as the engine's area test does (owner ruling O-47 of Witch Hunter 804051 states the same reach for Nearby, AscensionWitchHunterSummons.cpp:374-380): the effective centre distance is 10 + 1.5 (player combat reach, race 1, the Templar combat_reach read) + 1.275 (dummy entry 36 combat reach, creature_model_info display 367, read in the Templar and Witch Hunter radius_edge runs) = 12.775 yd. Two dummies, one at 12.275 yd (9.5 yd of the surface distance, inside) and one at 13.275 yd (10.5 yd, outside), their damage summed: exactly one hit of 404..456 means the first was hit and the second was not (two hits would read 808..912, as the first exploratory run read 908 with the second dummy at 11 yd, inside 12.775). The band 9.5 .. 10.5 yd excludes 5% either side of the stated 10 yd. Control (before): the same Bless without the 503505 cast, no damage. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 503505: 0 events; the bindmysoul snapshot has no value for this spell; nothing found.

behaviours.quote: Avoiding an attack now has a $h% chance to grant you Angelic Presence.
behaviours.name: Angelic Presence (next Illumination is instant cast)
behaviours.observe_source: Quote: the Description of 92137 holds only the grant sentence; the Angelic Presence clause "Your next Illumination within $d is instant cast and free of cost." belongs to the ledger row of this spell (clause 7) and its words come from the tooltip of 800722, so the entry hangs under the grant sentence. 92137 Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 800722 (ProcChance 20); AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:98 and :252: a received avoided attack rolls Chance(player, 92137) (ProcChance 20, no cooldown) and casts Angelic Presence 800722 on the caster. 800722 Effect[1] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER MiscValue 14 (SPELLMOD_COST) BasePoints -1001 and Effect[0] aura 108 MiscValue 10 (SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME) BasePoints -101, class mask word 2 = 512 (AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp:146-149 sets Effects[1] mask to 512, the Illumination family flag; Illumination 500143: cast time 2000 ms, cost 30% of the base mana 1363 = 408.9, as the Resplendence 806159 entries read). The proc is rolled for real: the striker (creature 36) casts Speed Slash 2118233 (melee class, SPELL_ATTR7_NO_ATTACK_MISS, can be parried) at the caster 40 times, 200 ms apart, the caster's parry set to 100% right before each (harness set_combat_avoidance, a named precondition fixture of both phases), so each is an avoided attack and a 20% roll: the residual probability that no proc happens in 40 rolls is 0.8^40 = 1.3e-4 per run, 2.6e-4 per pair (at most 0.1%). The passive is learned between the phases; the before phase is the same strikes without the passive (control). Holy Form 805301 is the trigger cast of both phases. The cast time of Illumination for the caster is read 500 ms after the strikes: 2000 ms before (control, no passive) and 0 ms after the learn. Reference search 2026-11-22: bindmysoul snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) reads "Your next Illumination within 15 seconds is instant cast and free of cost" (agrees); coa-history spell 800722: 166 applications and 68 refreshes in 6 and 5 logs, no cast time or cost read possible; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC for the values.

behaviours.name: Vow of the Valkyr (auto attack damage with the Vow cast)
behaviours.quote: and deal $s2% increased damage.
behaviours.observe_source: 807749 Effect[1] aura 112 SPELL_AURA_OVERRIDE_CLASS_SCRIPTS BasePoints 9 (+1 = 10, $s2): the Vow adds 10% to the auto attack damage the caster deals (AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp:354-355, AddPct(damage, Amount(807749, 1))). Behaviour: each phase auto attacks the dummy for 5 reference swing intervals with both Valkyr weapons (10 landed hits, as the swings entry reads), the first phase without the Vow (control), the second after a real cast of the Vow (gate_cast, no set_aura of the Vow), and melee_damage_total is cumulative over the scenario, so the after reading over the before reading is 1 + 1.10 = 2.10 for a bonus of 10%; the band is 2 points on the +10% (the larger of 5% of 10 and 2 points, G-19): 2.08 to 2.12. The attack power fixture 100000 makes the attack power part of a hit (about 20000 per main-hand swing) dominate the weapon roll of 73 to 103, so the per-hit spread is below 0.1% and the 2% band is excluded with a residual failure probability far below 0.1% per pair; force_crit melee (ADR 0692) sets the forced melee crit rating on the caster, so every hit of both phases is a critical strike alike, a precondition fixture that cancels in the ratio. The confound it removes: the contract remaps 807749 Effect[2] to SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (+5%, AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp:119-124), which would raise the crit rate of the after phase alone; with every hit forced to crit in both phases that term cannot move the ratio, and the +10% (AddPct on all caster melee damage, :362-364) is isolated. Misses would change the hit count between phases: a miss only alerts, never passes, because a different count moves the ratio outside the band (this entry does not read the hit count; the swings entry reads it in its own scenario). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 807749 (138 casts in 11 logs), 506823 and 506824 (1391 and 1388 Vow auto attack events); bindmysoul text identical to the streamed one; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC for the +10% value.

behaviours.observe_source: Expected from the tooltip and the DBC: 570187 Effect[0] BasePoints 79 with the 0.25 x attack power term at the reference attack power 70 gives the hit 96 (96.494 displayed, the ledger entry 190 hit at the measured stats), split by the number of enemy targets within radius index 14 = 8 yd (570187 Effect[0] TargetB 15 TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY around TargetA 22 TARGET_SRC_CASTER). The area search of a player caster adds the player's area leeway 2.66 yd to the radius (Spell.cpp:1388-1394, Object.cpp:1787-1808) and each non-player target's combat reach, 1.275 yd for the dummy entry 36 (Spell.cpp:9437-9442; creature_model_info 367), so the edge lies 8 + 2.66 + 1.275 = 11.935 yd from the caster (mentor D-259); the first design's area2 at 11 yd was inside it. Three enemies stand inside: the striker (3 yd), the dummy (5 yd) and area1 10% inside the edge (10.7415 yd); area2 stands 10% beyond it (13.1285 yd). The edge option reads the positions, reaches and run speed rate, voids a layout that does not bracket the stated edge, and alerts when area1 is unstruck or area2 struck. Each of the three takes 96 / 3 = 32, and the sum read on the dummy, area1 and area2 is 32 + 32 + 0 = 64. A server that does not split reads 192, one that counts and strikes area2 reads 24 + 24 + 24 = 72, one without the reach or the leeway leaves area1 out and reads 48 + 0 + 0 = 48; the tolerance 2 separates all of them. Control arm: before the gate (680637 not learned) the same heal and strike must read 0. The hit is made non-critical and unresisted by 984954 and 823764 (precondition fixtures, as the explosion entries). Reference search 2026-11-22: nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

behaviours.quote: When the absorption shield from The Chosen is depleted, it explodes for ${$570187m1*$<scalingbp>+$AP*0.25+$sph*0.45} Holy damage, split between enemies within $570187a1 yds.
behaviours.observe_source: 680637 Hope (Effect[0] aura 4 DUMMY) is a passive of the class script: when The Chosen's shield 802598 absorbs a hit at least as large as its remaining amount and the caster knows 680637, the script casts Hope 570187 at the caster (AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:168, Absorb :259-262; 570187 Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE BasePoints 79, TARGET_SRC_CASTER / TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY, radius index 14 = 8 yd); the hit is divided by the number of enemy targets (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:561-562), here one. The Chosen 704936 turns the heal of Illumination 500143 into the shield 802598 (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:375, entry shield_base), so the treatment is a real heal and a real strike: Grave Coil 47632 from a passive striker (creature 36, 3 yd from the caster) is far above the shield (11 to 12 at spell power 0) and breaks it. Every landed, unresisted, non-critical 570187 hit on the striker is judged against the tooltip read with the measured stats (base term with $<scalingbp>, 0.25 x attack power, 0.45 x holy spell power); 984954 removes spell crits (Effect[1] aura 57 BasePoints -1001) and adds weapon crit (Effect[0] aura 52 BasePoints 100) and 823764 partial resists on the caster (precondition fixtures, as the Sun Down entries). Control arm: the same heal and strike without 680637 learned must show no 570187 hit. The spell-power and attack-power arms raise the caster's stat before it is measured (10062, 10031) and are judged in the same pair against the same control (ADR 0745 / 0160: the base term is judged by the hit at the measured stats, each power term by its contrast arm). The striker is the only enemy within 8 yd, so the split is not exercised (a second enemy is not in this entry). Sizing: the exploratory read landed 28 of 30 trials as usable hits (a landed, non-critical hit); at a per-trial rate of 0.85, below that, 20 trials with a minimum of 8 usable hits fail with probability about 5e-7 per run, 1e-6 per pair.

behaviours.name: Suncharged (release at the end of Judgement Day)
behaviours.quote: At the end of the duration, or when Judgement Day ends, the enemy takes ${$807064m1*$<scalingbp>+$AP*.3+$sph*.5} Holy damage, increased for each stack on the target.
behaviours.observe_source: 804628 Suncharged lets Judgement Day apply Suncharge 807080 to the target every 0.5 s up to 10 stacks (entries suncharge_period and suncharge_cap). When Judgement Day 570125 ends (DurationIndex 9 = 30000 ms) the class script casts Suncharge 807064 at the target with the stacks read from 807080 (AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:187-191, ReleaseSuncharge AscensionSunCleric.cpp:326-334; 807064 Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE BasePoints 476). The treatment casts Judgement Day 806121 at the dummy and waits for its end; every landed, unresisted, non-critical 807064 hit on the dummy is read against the tooltip at the measured stats (base term with $<scalingbp>, 0.3 x attack power, 0.5 x holy spell power); 984954 removes spell crits (Effect[1] aura 57 BasePoints -1001) and adds weapon crit (Effect[0] aura 52 BasePoints 100) and 823764 partial resists on the caster (precondition fixtures). Control arm: the same cast without 804628 learned must show no 807064 hit. The spell-power and attack-power arms raise the caster's stat (10062, 10031) before it is measured and are judged in the same pair against the same control. The hit is read at the stacks cap, so the tooltip figure is multiplied by two factors of data, not of the measurement: 1 + 10 stacks x 0.25 (807080 Effect[0] aura 271 BasePoints 24 + 1 = 25% per stack; 10 = $807080u, the cap proven by suncharge_cap) = 3.5, and Judgement Day's own damage taken from the caster, 570125 Effect[1] aura 271 BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50% (the aura is still on the target when the release is cast), = 1.5; multiplier 5.25. The tooltip states no figure for the stack increase; the 25% is the data value the server applies (AscensionSunClericContracts.cpp:315-316). The exploratory read (the three arms at 5.25 times the tooltip figure) preceded this derivation. Sizing: 24 of 24 exploratory trials landed; at 0.85 per trial, 12 trials with a minimum of 5 usable hits fail with probability about 7e-5 per run, 1.4e-4 per pair.

behaviours.quote: At the end of the duration, or when Judgement Day ends, the enemy takes ${$807064m1*$<scalingbp>+$AP*.3+$sph*.5} Holy damage, increased for each stack on the target.

OUT OF SAMPLE arm (D-165, D-167): the harness removes Judgement Day 570125 from the dummy (set_aura stacks 0) as soon as 807080 reads exactly 1 stack on the dummy, which exercises the tooltip's 'when Judgement Day ends' branch (AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:187-189, any removal mode, Judgement Day still on the target: x1.5); a trial that never reads 1 stack voids the arm (SETUP assert) and is not judged. Prediction committed in e23cddb195 before this arm existed: 492.0 x (1 + 1 x 0.25) x 1.5 = 922.5, tolerated band 5%; multiplier 1.875 = (1 + 1 x 0.25) x 1.5 from 807080 Effect[0] BasePoints 24 + 1 and 570125 Effect[1] BasePoints 49 + 1 (data). Clean start (D-174, fix2): 806121 lands Judgement Day about 150 ms after the cast (Effect[0] 183 delayed trigger, BasePoints 149; Spell::EffectAscensionTriggerSpellDelayed, SpellEffects.cpp:1061-1100), so a removal straight after the cast removes nothing and the control arm leaves Judgement Day (30000 ms) on the dummy. The harness therefore removes Judgement Day once more after the control drain and before 804628 is learned, every treatment trial starts only if 570125 is absent and 807080 holds no stack on the dummy, and each removal follows a read that 570125 is present; a trial that breaks one of these voids the arm (SETUP asserts).

behaviours.name: Final Vows (Horusath Blast can be cast again 10% sooner after a fulfilment) (without arm alone)
behaviours.quote: Fulfilling your Vow of Grace now also reduces the cooldown of the triggered ability by 10%.

cast_auras.reason: Dawn 804584 carries CasterAuraSpell 704396 (helper aura set at 20 Solar Power by AscensionSunCleric.cpp:260 and :357) and its fulfilment is SpendDawn (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:105-115); 500149 is set at 20 stacks on the caster before the Dawn cast, a named precondition fixture; the claim measured is the cooldown cut.

823764 (Effect[0] aura 123 MOD_TARGET_RESISTANCE -9999 removes the dummy's resists; Effect[1] aura 108 +100% SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 matches neither 500154 nor 570034) and 984954 (Effect[1] aura 57 -1000 removes the caster's natural spell crit chance; Effect[0] aura 52 MOD_WEAPON_CRIT_PERCENT +101% does not reach the magic 500154), set before every Horusath Blast cast as in the cd entry: precondition fixtures, the claim measured is the cooldown cut. The generated scenario also sets 704396 (20 Solar Power, the CasterAuraSpell of 804584) with set_aura before each Dawn cast: a precondition fixture, not the claim.

behaviours.observe_source: 707528 Final Vows Effect[0] aura 107 BasePoints 9 (+1 = 10) and Effect[2] aura 107 carry no cooldown percent; the 10% is applied by the class code (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:293-294: after a Horusath Blast cast made after a Dawn fulfilment with Vow of Grace 803719 and Final Vows on the caster, ReducePercent(player, id, |Amount(707528)|)). Horusath Blast 500154 has RecoveryTime 25000 ms, so 10% is 2500 ms. Route: the cooldown cost_gate (guide section 2, Lorescribe), a cast the server accepts or refuses, not a cooldown readback. Vow of Grace 803719 and Dawn 804584 (20 Solar Power) are cast in every arm before the priming Horusath Blast, 707528 is learned in the arms with it. The gated cast is attempted 22500 + 150 ms after the priming cast (accepted with it, refused without it) and 22500 - 150 ms after it (refused): a cut of 9% (2250 ms) or 11% (2750 ms) would make the beyond arm accepted or the with arm refused. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 707528: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); the ascension-data snapshot rows carry the acquisition and no value; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC for the 10%. Conversion round D-195 (2026-11-22): this scenario runs the without arm alone (cost_gate only_arm, ADR 1205), so no other arm leaves Dawn, the Vow or a cooldown behind. Dawn toggle (#5741, PR #6809, AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:513-519): Dawn 804584 is cast exactly once, before the priming Horusath Blast, with no Dawn up, so it activates; the earlier design cast it twice per arm (an after cast to cancel Dawn) and the arms shared one caster. Dawn 807440 and the Vow aura 803719 are read on the caster right before the priming cast and must both be present, else the arm is voided (priming_reads).

The server turns creatures toward their target (Spell.cpp:3937) but never a player, and a player cast needs the target inside the 180 degree front arc (Spell.cpp:7351-7352), waived inside max(boundary radius, 2) yd (Unit.cpp:954-962). Position reads (position_x, position_y, position_o, distance) in 32 short copies without a relocate: the five attackers settle on a 3.0 yd circle around the caster, attacker1 at -40..+73 degrees from the +x facing; a first relocate of +3 yd (onto the spawn point) put attacker1 at +-107 degrees, accepted only under 2 yd, and 4 of 24 copies were refused. relocate_dx -1 moves the caster 1 yd back along x: the front arc then covers attackers up to 109 degrees (cos >= -1/3) and the farthest attacker is at most sqrt(10 + 6 cos) = 4.0 yd, inside the 5 yd minimum melee range; 96 of 96 short copies were accepted (angle at most 59 degrees, distance 3.39 to 4.00 yd). Both arms are counted after the move. Class-end pair 2026-11-23 (20261123-105051 / -112044): all 81 casts of 500154 in part 6 of run 2 refused with reason 134 again, about 1 refused part in 160 at relocate -1. Cause measured (diag2 20261123-121453, 16 copies at -1.8 and 16 at -1.0 with position reads after the relocate, at every cycle end and before the first cast): the caster's orientation stays 0, and the attackers keep their distance to the caster but slide around it during the 640 s control arm (in the refused copy attacker1 goes from +21 to +109 degrees). No relocate distance can bound a drift that comes after the move: -1.8 was tried (mentor D-319) and refused 1 of 16 copies, so -1.0 is kept (mentor D-321) with this known residual; a refused part is unmeasured and names its refused casts as an invalid setup. No existing harness step turns a player toward a unit; a face-unit step is the owner's (G-39).

behaviours.observe_source: Horusath Blast 572801 Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_SCHOOL_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints 769, EffectDieSides 107, EffectRealPointsPerLevel 6.32 from BaseLevel 58, SchoolMask 2 (Holy), CastingTimeIndex 1 (instant), ManaCostPercentage 33, RecoveryTime 25000 ms (Spell.dbc, server set). $m1 at level 60 = 769 + int32(2 x 6.32) + 1..107 = 782..888 (the tooltip reads 782.64 at the reference stats, the low end); the coefficient is the stated $sph*1, i.e. 1.0 x Holy spell power. One real cast on the dummy with 984954 (no spell crit: Effect[1] aura 57 at -1001; its Effect[0] aura 52 weapon crit +101% does not reach Horusath Blast, DmgClass 1, Holy) and 823764 (no magic resistance: aura 123 at -9999 on mask 126; its Effect[1] aura 108 +100% SPELLMOD_EFFECT1 on family 33 mask word 2 0x20000000 does not match Horusath Blast's flags[1] 64) as harness precondition fixtures. With 10000 spell power (player_spell_power hit_arm, harness fixture, the Holy spell power read before the hit is recorded on the verdict) the hit is 782..888 + int32(1.0 x 10000) = [10782, 10889]; a coefficient 10% off (0.9 or 1.1) reads about 1000 away and is excluded. Contrast arm: damage_base in the same pair. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history map spell 500154 (the same-name Horusath Blast) has 1073 cast events in the index, no damage figure that fixes a coefficient (players' gear differs); bindmysoul snapshot carries the same sentence; nothing else found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

behaviours.name: Cultivate Divinity (the next Illumination after an effective Radiant Cascade heal)
behaviours.quote: to increase the healing of your next Illumination by $301293s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: $301293s1 = 20 (percent, aura 301293 Effect[0] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER BasePoints 19 + 1), so the next Illumination 500143 heals 1.20 times the control (the stated 20%, from the DBC, never from the ratio). The proc roll is roll_chance_i(ProcChance of 704920 = 20%) in AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:338, one roll per effective Radiant Cascade 500141 heal on the ally; the aura is earned for real: control trials cancel 301293 and cast Illumination 500143 at the ally, treatment trials cast Radiant Cascade 500141 at the ally every 3500 ms (cast_until_aura, max_casts computed from the 20% chance so that a trial left unfed has probability at most 0.001 per pair of runs), then cast Illumination 500143 at the ally and cast it once more right after: the second cast must be back at the control mean (the tooltip says 'next': consumed once). The aura is read on the caster right before the judged cast (0 in the control, 1 in the treatment, else the run is unmeasured; the harness never sets it). The ally is set to 1 health of a 2000000000 maximum before every trial so every heal on it is effective; only non-critical heals on the ally count; the 99% Welch-t interval of the ratio must lie inside 1.18 to 1.22 (the DBC figure 20% +-10%, G-19, ADR 1202). The aura is ADD_PCT_MODIFIER on SPELLMOD_DAMAGE (EffectMiscValue[0] 0), which multiplies the whole heal, spell power part included (Unit::SpellHealingBonusDone, Unit.cpp:10928-10932: heal = (base + spell power bonus) x done mods, then ApplySpellMod SPELLMOD_DAMAGE), so the spell power fixture of 20000 narrows the dice share without changing what is tested. Trials sized before the run from earlier measurements at 20000 spell power (560547 illumination entry, pair 20261122-143800 / 20261122-150434): single Illumination heals of standard deviation 0.89 of 16839 (coefficient of variation 0.005%); 12 trials per arm give a ratio standard error at most about 0.0012, while a false alert of at most 0.1% per pair needs at most 0.0033 (2.576 + 3.48 standard errors inside the 0.02 half-band). The second-cast check keeps the DBC dice spread of Illumination 500143. Tool: aura_fed_effect heal variant (Sun Cleric tool ADR 1202). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 704920: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); no reference snapshot carries a figure beyond the tooltip; nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Bless (mana per tick)
behaviours.quote: and 5% of your maximum mana every 10 sec for 5 min.
behaviours.observe_source: Bless 804247 costs ManaCostPercentage 20 of BaseMana 1363 (player_class_stats class 27 level 60) = 272, instant; Effect[0] aura 227 every 10000 ms triggers 805360, whose Effect[0] BasePoints 4 with DieSides 1 gives 5 (spell_dbc 805360 EffectBasePoints_2 = 4, rev_20261121_01_sun_cleric_bless_mana_five_percent.sql, owner ruling O-4); AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:213-219 adds CalculatePct(max mana, Amount(805360,1)) on the caster's own tick. Maximum mana read with the max_power metric: 2868, so one tick is 5% of 2868 = 143 (143.4 truncated). Mana is set to 1363 at the start of both phases (phase_power with phase_power_in_uncast_before) with regeneration off. Control phase: Bless is known but not cast, the mana reads 1363. Treatment phase: Bless is cast on the caster and read 10500 ms later (one tick): 1363 - 272 (cost) + 143 = 1234. The expected value comes from the tooltip percent, the DBC mana cost percent and the maximum mana, not from a run. A tick of 1%, 2%, 4% or 6% reads 1119, 1148, 1205 or 1263 and is excluded (exact read, tolerance 1e-5). The 300357 doubling is measured by mana_tick_lead. Reference search: coa-history spell 804247 (347 casts in 27 logs) and 805360 (5324 heal and 2930 energize events in 30 and 12 logs, mean 871 and 974); bindmysoul 804247 reads "Bless an ally, restoring 5% of their maximum health every 10 sec for 5 minutes" (no self cast and no mana, an older state, G-9); owner ruling O-4 (2026-11-21) sets the mana to 5% of the maximum per tick, Sun Cleric ADR 0002. Nothing found that gives a live per tick mana percent beyond the ruling.

behaviours.name: Solar Concord (Horusath Blast recast in Sunrise)
behaviours.quote: Resets the cooldown of Horusath Blast while in Sunrise and Rapture while in Sunset and causes their damage dealt to launch a Solar Flare.

cast_auras.reason: Sunrise 500477 and the Sunrise-or-Sunset checker 500643 (CasterAuraSpell of 301266) are set on the caster before the Solar Concord cast: named precondition fixtures; the claim measured is the cooldown reset the cast applies, not the phase condition.

behaviours.observe_source: 301266 Solar Concord resets the cooldowns through Effect[1] TRIGGER_SPELL 302899 and Effect[2] TRIGGER_SPELL 301268 (301268 Effect[0] 195 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN MiscValue 500154; 302899 Effect[0] 195 MiscValue 806477; handler SpellEffects.cpp:1103-1112). Neither has a CasterAuraSpell, and a triggered cast would ignore one (TRIGGERED_IGNORE_CASTER_AURASTATE, Spell.cpp:5929-5938). Owner ruling O-26: the class script prevents the 301268 reset outside Sunrise 500477 and the 302899 reset outside Sunset 500511 (spell_ascension_sun_cleric_ability, AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:509-510, ADR conformance/sun-cleric 0033); the aura-apply reset that repeated it in phase is removed. Horusath Blast has RecoveryTime 25000 ms. The cooldown cost_gate (resets) casts Horusath Blast as the priming cast, then Solar Concord 1600 ms later (the cast is made in the with arm only), then attempts Horusath Blast again 1600 ms after that (past the global cooldown of the Solar Concord cast), inside its 25000 ms cooldown: refused without the Solar Concord cast (the control, SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY), accepted with it. The accepted or refused cast is an event (cast_failure), not a cooldown readback. The without arm drops both the Solar Concord cast and the phase aura, so it proves the reset by the cast and not the words "while in Sunrise": that phase condition is read by the other-phase entries (reset_horusath_sunset, reset_rapture_sunrise).

behaviours.name: Day Cycles (Horusath Blast cooldown cut in Sunrise)
behaviours.quote: While in Sunrise, the remaining cooldown of Horusath Blast is reduced by $301176s2% every $t1 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: 300361 Day Cycles Effect[0] aura 23 PERIODIC_TRIGGER_SPELL, EffectAmplitude 1000 ($t1 = 1000 ms), triggers 301176 whose Effect[1] EffectBasePoints 9 + 1 = 10 ($301176s2). AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:222-228: each tick with the Sunrise aura 500477 calls ReducePercent on Horusath Blast 500154 and with the Sunset aura 500511 on Rapture 806477, cutting 10% of the remaining cooldown of every known spell of that name. The Sunrise or Sunset aura is a named precondition fixture (phase_auras of both phases): it is the state the clause names, not its subject. Horusath Blast: RecoveryTime 25000 ms; Rapture: RecoveryTime 20000 ms, cast time 3000 ms (CastingTimeIndex 14). The gate learn starts the aura; the cast follows within a few steps, so the ticks fall at about 1000, 2000 ... ms after the cooldown starts, minus the small step delay eps (0 to 200 ms). Model of the remaining cooldown at the read, ticking 10% of the remaining after each elapsed second: 10577 at eps 0, 10536 at eps 100, 10495 at eps 200 ms. A tick of 8% reads 12056 and 12% reads 9230 (eps 0), more than 1000 ms away; tolerance 300 ms is below 10% of the reading (1053 ms) on both sides. The read is stamped (game_time after window) so the elapsed time is judged. The control phase reads the same cast without the passive, and the control entry reads the other day-cycle aura with the passive: no reduction.  Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 300361: 0 events in 186 logs; bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries the same words (agrees; the entry Day Cycles is Piety, level 50). Limit (review c5 I-1): the read does not measure the tick period. A period of 1100 ms reads 10421 with the same model, inside 10536 +- 300, so the 10% per tick is measured and "every $t1 sec" is not; cooldown_ms is a READBACK metric, so the entry is data and not behaviour. A tick-aligned cooldown read is tool group 5 item 5 (tool need, returned).

AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:222-228: each tick with the Sunrise aura 500477 calls ReducePercent on Horusath Blast 500154 and with the Sunset aura 500511 on Rapture 806477, cutting 10% of the remaining cooldown of every known spell of that name. The Sunrise or Sunset aura is a named precondition fixture (phase_auras of both phases): it is the state the clause names, not its subject. Horusath Blast: RecoveryTime 25000 ms; Rapture: RecoveryTime 20000 ms, cast time 3000 ms (CastingTimeIndex 14). The gate learn starts the aura; the cast follows within a few steps, so the ticks fall at about 1000, 2000 ... ms after the cooldown starts, minus the small step delay eps (0 to 200 ms). The control phase reads the same cast without the passive, and the control entry reads the other day-cycle aura with the passive: no reduction.  Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 300361: 0 events in 186 logs; bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries the same words (agrees; the entry Day Cycles is Piety, level 50). Design 2 (the first design read 6436: the tick grid fell on the end of the 3000 ms cast, a sixth tick landed at the cooldown start). A setup cast of Holy Form 805301 and its 1600 ms wait before the Rapture cast shift the grid by 600 ms, so after the cooldown starts (read 5000 ms later, 8000 ms after the cast) the ticks fall at about 400, 1400, 2400, 3400 and 4400 ms minus eps (0 to 200): 7797, 7838 and 7879 at eps 200, 100 and 0; 8% reads about 9000 and 12% about 6760, more than 1000 ms away; the read before the learn is 20000 - 5000 = 15000. Limit (review c5 I-1): the read does not measure the tick period. With the same model a period of 900 ms reads 7993 and 1100 ms reads 7887, both inside 7838 +- 300, so the 10% per tick is measured and "every $t1 sec" is not; cooldown_ms is a READBACK metric, so the entry is data and not behaviour. behaviours.name: Solar Concord (Horusath Blast recast in Sunrise) (cast in Sunset, the other phase)
behaviours.quote: Resets the cooldown of Horusath Blast while in Sunrise and Rapture while in Sunset and causes their damage dealt to launch a Solar Flare.

cast_auras.reason: Sunset 500511 and the Sunrise-or-Sunset checker 500643 (CasterAuraSpell of 301266) are set on the caster before the Solar Concord cast: named precondition fixtures; this is the other phase, where the tooltip ('while in Sunrise') says no reset happens.

behaviours.observe_source: 301266 Solar Concord resets the cooldowns through Effect[1] TRIGGER_SPELL 302899 and Effect[2] TRIGGER_SPELL 301268 (301268 Effect[0] 195 SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_RESET_COOLDOWN MiscValue 500154; 302899 Effect[0] 195 MiscValue 806477; handler SpellEffects.cpp:1103-1112). Neither has a CasterAuraSpell, and a triggered cast would ignore one (TRIGGERED_IGNORE_CASTER_AURASTATE, Spell.cpp:5929-5938). Owner ruling O-26: the class script prevents the 301268 reset outside Sunrise 500477 and the 302899 reset outside Sunset 500511 (spell_ascension_sun_cleric_ability, AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:509-510, ADR conformance/sun-cleric 0033); the aura-apply reset that repeated it in phase is removed. Horusath Blast has RecoveryTime 25000 ms. The cooldown cost_gate (resets) casts Horusath Blast as the priming cast, then Solar Concord 1600 ms later (the cast is made in the with arm only), then attempts Horusath Blast again 1600 ms after that (past the global cooldown of the Solar Concord cast), inside its 25000 ms cooldown: refused without the Solar Concord cast (the control, SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY), accepted with it. The accepted or refused cast is an event (cast_failure), not a cooldown readback. Other-phase arm (tool 1, ADR 1203 provisional): Solar Concord is cast with Sunset 500511 on the caster, so the tooltip words 'while in Sunrise' expect the recast of 500154 refused in the with arm as in the without arm (SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY). Before O-26 the DBC effects reset both cooldowns in either phase (pairs x3, x4 and y1: cast_failure 0 against 67); the class script now prevents the out-of-phase reset (ADR conformance/sun-cleric 0033). Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 301266 (88 casts, no cooldown event); nothing else found.

behaviours.name: Twilight (Fulfillment of Vow of the Eclipse copies twice the damage)
behaviours.quote: In addition, increases the effectiveness of the Fulfillment effect of Vow of the Eclipse by $s2%.
behaviours.observe_source: 704579 Twilight Effect[1] aura 108, BasePoints 99 + 1 = +100% ($s2). The server code reads it as pct = Amount(807444, 1) (Dawn 807444 Effect[1], BasePoints 9 + 1 = 10) times (100 + 100)% when 704579 is known (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:231-236), the Fulfillment copy of Vow of the Eclipse 807435 on a marked enemy; the expectation is the tooltip's +100%, so the copy a Dawn-fulfilled Sunflare 800231 causes (Sun Power 807215 damage events on the dummy) doubles once 704579 is learned. Setup: Vow of the Eclipse 807435, Dawn 807440 with one charge and the Eclipse mark 505340 on the dummy (the caster's own, Eclipse(), AscensionSunCleric.cpp:312-322) are applied by harness set_aura as precondition fixtures in both phases (the subject is the Fulfillment copy, not the mark or the Vow; a first cast as the mark was measured and left the arms unequal: the mark outlives the before phase, so the after phase's first cast copied as well while the before phase's did not), then the judged Sunflare 800231 lands on the marked dummy with Dawn up in both phases; the control phase without 704579 learned reads the 10% copy of the hit. Crit and resist removed (984954 removes the caster's natural spell crit; 823764 removes the dummy's resistances) and spell power 20000 narrows the damage dice so the copy tracks the hit it is a share of. spell_damage_total is cumulative on the dummy, so the after reading is the control copy plus the learned one: the control copy c (10%) and the after-phase copy 2c (+100%) read c then 3c, and the judged ratio is 3.0; +100% passes from 1.95 to 2.05 of the copy (G-19, the larger of 5% of 100% and 2 points is 5 points), that is a ratio from 2.95 to 3.05, tolerance 0.1 on the ratio (2.9 to 3.1). The reads wait 4000 ms because the copy lands late (a 1500 ms wait read the before-phase copy after the learn). behaviours.name: Stalwart (no second critical hit: Vulnerable Tier 10 425, +100%, spaced Strikes, the aura is gone at 5.4 s)
behaviours.observe_source: 300355 Stalwart Effect[0] aura 42 proc-triggers 301342 (DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms), whose Effect[0] aura 197 has EffectBasePoints -1001 (Spell.dbc). Eight Strikes Hateful Strike 28308 (D-277: replaces Strike 11976, which can miss, so an all-miss run read the expected 0: DmgClass 2, melee, Effect[0] 31 WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE, EffectBasePoints 99 + 1 = 100% weapon damage on EffectImplicitTargetA 6, SpellFamilyName 0, AttributesEx3 SPELL_ATTR3_ALWAYS_HIT, no spell script or proc row) 500 ms apart hit the caster, so the last lands at 3.5 s, inside the 4 s window; the aura is read about 5.4 s after the first Strike. Fixture Vulnerable 425 (Effect[1] aura 197, EffectBasePoints 99 = +100% to be critically struck, harness set_aura, not the subject) makes the first Strike critical (base chance plus 100%) and, summed with 301342, leaves -901%, so no later Strike is critical and 301342 is not re-granted: it ends 4 s after the first landed Strike, before the read. A re-granted aura would last until at least 7.5 s. Unit::MeleeSpellHitResult returns SPELL_MISS_NONE for SPELL_ATTR3_ALWAYS_HIT (Unit.cpp:3752-3753) and Unit::isSpellBlocked returns false for it (Unit.cpp:3686-3687), so every Strike lands: it cannot miss, be dodged, parried or blocked, and an all-miss trial cannot occur; the critical roll is made on the damage calculation, apart from the hit result (Unit.cpp:16901). The first Strike therefore lands at 0 s and is critical (base chance plus 100%), so the grant is certain and the read at 5.4 s finds it ended.

behaviours.name: Flames of Absolution (radius edge around the struck target: 5 yd plus both object sizes, 10% bracket)
behaviours.quote: Damage dealt by Horusath Blast now launches a Solar Flare at up to $573449i enemies within $573449a1 yds of your target.
behaviours.reach_source: the dummy entry 36 combat reach 1.275 yd (read 1.275 on every dummy in diagnostic run 20261122-081052; the judge reads each reach again and refuses a layout that does not bracket the edge). The centre is the struck target, as the tooltip says ("of your target"): the handler of case 804632 lists Nearby(target, Radius(573449)) (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:314, AscensionSunCleric.cpp:138-146), whose AnyUnitInObjectRangeCheck uses IsWithinDistInMap with both object sizes (GridNotifiers.h:1061-1070, Object.cpp:1257-1264, GetObjectSize = combat reach, Object.cpp:2898-2901), so the edge is 5 + 1.275 + 1.275 = 7.55 yd centre to centre; the rule is the accepted effective radius (class-conformance.md section 5, both object sizes for script checks, G-29). Margin 0.755 = 10% of 7.55: inside 6.795 yd, outside 8.305 yd from the primary, which stands 3 yd from the caster. The wait after each cast is 3000 ms: the flares travel (diagnostic runs 20261122-215449 to -215850: a flare reads 0 at 1000 ms when the caster-to-dummy path is long and 1 at 4000 ms). behaviours.name: Dawn's Arrival (free Gavel earned from Dawnbreak)
behaviours.quote: causes the next one to not incur a cooldown.
behaviours.observe_source: Route: real Dawnbreak 800654 casts every 1700 ms (cast_until_aura, owner ruling O-17) until the free-Gavel aura 503691 is on the caster; the harness never sets it (D-145). Code: the grant and the reset sit in one block, one roll: AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:282-287 (if Chance(player, 503690): Reduce INT32_MAX on Gavel roots 800611, 800614, 800617, then Cast 503691); Chance() rolls the raw ProcChance 40 of 503690 (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:196-205), so the trials that read the aura also read the reset. The free cast: :291-292 (a Gavel carrying script value 503691 is reduced to no cooldown). Reads: cooldown_ms is readback data (the server cooldown map), so the behaviour is the recast: a second real Gavel 1600 ms after the first goes off (spell_go_count, cast_failure 0) in the treatment and is refused with SPELL_FAILED_NOT_READY 67 in the control (no aura), and a third in the treatment is refused (only the next cast is free). Reset: a Gavel of Light 800611 is cast first (CategoryRecoveryTime 5000 in Spell.dbc), 1600 ms later the feed starts; a feed that reaches the aura at its first or second cast finds the Gavel still cooling naturally (3400 or 1700 ms left), so a read of 0 right after the aura appeared is the reset; later casts find it over and are not judged (spell_go_count of 800654 gives the casts per trial). Control: the same Gavel without the feed reads 3400 and 1700 ms left (natural cooldown, within 10%). The free read starts from a Gavel reset as a precondition fixture so it does not depend on the reset claim. Sizing: ProcChance 40, so a trial is judged for the reset with probability 1 - 0.6^2 = 0.64; 8 trials leave a run with no judged trial at 0.36^8 = 2.8e-4 (5.7e-4 per pair, unmeasured, never a false verdict); max_casts 19 keeps an unfed trial at most 0.001 per pair. A correct server has no random outcome in a judged trial. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 503690: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); 503691: 280 SPELL_AURA_APPLIED and 280 SPELL_AURA_REMOVED in 5 logs, no cooldown or cast event, so a free Gavel is not told apart there; Dawnbreak 800654: 284 SPELL_CAST_SUCCESS in 4 logs; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC. Tool: aura_fed_effect cooldown variant (Sun Cleric tool ADR 1206).

behaviours.name: Calm (an enemy player's Auto Shots stop)

enemy_shooter.source: Witch Hunter (class 15) with the crossbow of the 'Boltslinger' set of witch_hunter.json (item 15809, slot 17, skill line 226). Control: the same enemy shoots 6000 ms with no Calm on it and must fire exactly 3 Auto Shots (SPELL_GO of 75) there, the planned count; the trial is void unless it fired at least one.

behaviours.observe_source: Calm 804057 Effect[1] aura 67 MOD_DISARM and Effect[2] aura 254 MOD_DISARM_OFFHAND, no aura 278 in the DBC (read 2026-11-22); the class contract puts it in Effect[0] and the class casts the trigger 807778 on the hit target (Sun Cleric ADR 0039). Enemy player race 2. Calm on a player (not Undead or Demon) refuses its trigger 807778 with reason 27 (SPELL_FAILED_DONT_REPORT), and the ranged disarm interrupts the Auto Shot the enemy is repeating, reason 40 (SPELL_FAILED_INTERRUPTED): aura 278 applies through AuraEffect::HandleAuraModDisarm, which calls Player::ApplyItemDependentAuras(item, false) and Player::RemoveItemDependentAurasAndCasts, and that interrupts the current spell whose weapon requirement no other useable item meets (Player::HasItemFitToSpellRequirements through Player::GetUseableItemByPos and Unit::CanUseAttackType(RANGED_ATTACK), Unit.h:1004); Spell::cancel sends reason 40 for a spell still preparing. Both refusals are native to the cast and are stated in native_refusals; any other refusal voids the ranged trial. The pre-fix pair 20261123-075212 / 20261123-075514 ran this scenario with the control window unchanged and recorded no refusal of 75, with 3 shots in the control; the judged reading is the shot count. Auto Shot 75 SPELL_GO count of the enemy. Planned count of the control: 3. The enemy's ranged attack time reads 2434.78 ms (attack_time_ms hand 2 on the enemy with the crossbow 15809 equipped, probe run 20261123-085810; the item's speed is 2800 ms, so the shooter carries a 15% ranged haste, 2800 / 2434.78 = 1.15; its source is Auto Shot 75: the Witch Hunter gets +15% ranged attack speed from Auto Shot's own text, a literal of the Spell.dbc description with no DBC aura behind it, applied by Unit::ApplyAttackTimePercentMod(RANGED_ATTACK, 15) from AscensionWitchHunterCompletion.cpp:515-548 on login and on every learn (owner ruling O-21, docs/adr/conformance/witch-hunter/0006-auto-shot-gives-a-witch-hunter-15-percent-ranged-attack-speed.md)); the Auto Shot count of the control read 1 within 500 ms, 2 within 2500 ms, 3 within 5000 ms and 4 within 7500 ms in four probe runs (20261123-085716, 500 ms slices), so the first shot falls within 500 ms of the cast and the next ones follow every 2434.78 ms: shots at t0, t0 + 2434.78 and t0 + 4869.56 lie inside the 6000 ms window for every t0 in [0, 500] ms (the last one at 5370 ms at the latest, 630 ms before the window ends) and the fourth at t0 + 7304.34 ms, at least 1304 ms after it ends, so the window holds exactly 3 shots and a fourth cannot appear in it. Control: the window with no Calm must read exactly the planned 3 (before_expected 3 at tolerance 0: a refused or interrupted control shot reads less and alerts; more than 3 cannot occur by the interval), and the window with Calm on the enemy (1000 ms + 5000 ms, the aura read first; the next shot after the control window falls at t0 + 7304 ms, at least about 700 ms after Calm lands) must add 0 shots (the tooltip says ranged weapons are disarmed). Precondition (mentor D-314): the enemy's ranged attack time (attack_time_ms, hand 2) is read before the control window and must be 2434.78 ms within 0.5 ms (2800 ms / 1.15, the Auto Shot 75 haste above); any other value, or no read, voids the trial (unmeasured), because the control count of 3 and the 6000 ms window are derived from that interval. Reference search 2026-11-22: nothing found beyond the tooltip, the DBC and the engine code cited.

behaviours.name: Justice (main-hand strike hit)
behaviours.observe_source: Justice 572848 Effect[0] TRIGGER_SPELL 572850 (main hand, Physical, SchoolMask 1) and Effect[1] TRIGGER_SPELL 572045 (off hand, Fire, SchoolMask 4); each strike has Effect[0] SPELL_EFFECT_WEAPON_PERCENT_DAMAGE BasePoints 49 (50%, the $524857s1 of the tooltip) and Effect[1] SCHOOL_DAMAGE flat: 572850 BasePoints 156 (157), 572045 BasePoints 104 (105), EffectDieSides 1 (value = BasePoints + 1). The tooltip token $524857m2 reads 6 (524857 Effect[1] BasePoints 5, a tooltip-only spell), the served flats are 157 and 105: this entry reads the hit the server really deals per hand, and its bounds come from the served DBC values, not from the token. Valkyr weapon set (spell_weapon_sets 572848): 2529 in both hands, 73.62-103.34, 2800 ms; reference attack power 70, so the attack-power part of one hit is 70/14 x 2.8 = 14; spell power 0 so the $spfi*0.2 part is 0; melee and expertise rating 10000, non-critical hits only, Fire resistance of the dummy removed by 823764. Armor of the harness dummy, from the data: Harvest Golem 36 (creature_template: unit_class 1, ArmorModifier 1, minlevel 11), min_level_armor pins its base armor to ceil(creature_classlevelstats basearmor at level 11 class 1 x ArmorModifier) = 528 (CoAGameplayTest.cpp:3507-3512, CreatureData.h:336-339; the diagnostic entry Fanaticism dummy_armor reads 528 back). Classic combat rules (ClassicPlus.CombatRules = 1, both units at level 60, IsClassicPlusCombat, Unit.cpp:133-137) mitigate with t = armor / ArmorConstant(60) = 528 / 5500 (ClassicPlusCombat.h:137-140), kept fraction 1 - t/(1+t) = 5500/6028 = 0.912409 (Unit.cpp:2547-2554), applied once to the whole hit as uint32(ceil(damage x fraction)). Weapon part of one hit, in the engine's order: roll = urand(uint32(min), uint32(max)) with min = 73.62 + 14 = 87.62 and max = 103.34 + 14 = 117.34 (item_template 2529: dmg 73.62-103.34, delay 2800; Player::CalculateMinMaxDamage, StatSystem.cpp:693-768; the scenario reads attack_power 70 and weapon_damage_min 87.62 back), so the roll is an integer 87..117 (Unit.cpp:3558-3612); the 50% (BasePoints 49) is ApplyPct on that integer and truncates, W = floor(roll / 2) = 43..58 (Util.h:50-67, SpellEffects.cpp:4724-4742). The roll is not recorded by an existing read, so the interval is the envelope over the 31 integer rolls: two runs that differ by one point are two rolls inside it, never a flip outside it. Main hand, Physical: W + the flat 157 = 200..215 before armor (a flat of 157 is exact: CalcValue int32 of 157.0, SpellInfo.cpp:479-599), times 0.912409 with the ceil, 183..197: interval [183, 197]. Control: no cast before, 0 damage. The 6-flat reading (tooltip token) would give 50% x (87.6..117.3) + 6 = 49.8..64.7 before armor, outside the interval. Reference search 2026-11-22: nothing found beyond the tooltip and the DBC.

behaviours.name: Purgation (Holy damage taken at 8 stacks)
behaviours.quote: increases the target's Holy and Fire damage taken from you by $806025s1%
behaviours.expected_source: 806024 Purgation Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 806025 (Purgation debuff); the class code casts 806025 on the target of every own damage hit of Radiant Flame 807058 (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:116, :316). 806025 Effect[0] aura 271 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER MiscValue 6 (Holy 2 + Fire 4), BasePoints 0 + 1 = 1 ($806025s1), DurationIndex 31 (8000 ms, $806025d), StackAmount 8 ($806025U). Radiant Flame 806060 lasts DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms with EffectAmplitude 1000, so one cast ticks 807058 five times (SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD, an extra tick on apply). Eight stacks of 1% = +8% (band 2 points, G-19: the larger of 5% of 8 and 2 points; the interval excludes the control 1.0 and a 2% or 0.5% per stack aura). Holy damage: Horusath Blast 500154 (SchoolMask 2 Holy) is read per arm after two Radiant Flame casts 1600 ms apart (the stack cap is 8). Fixtures: spell penetration 823764 on the caster (precondition fixture, never the subject); Radiant Flame 806060 is cast for real twice before every observed cast in both arms (the real Purgation stacks are the subject, no set_aura of 806025); the control arm makes the same two casts without 806024 learned. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 806025 (the Purgation debuff): 221 SPELL_AURA_APPLIED, 825 SPELL_AURA_APPLIED_DOSE, 352 SPELL_AURA_REFRESH and 221 SPELL_AURA_REMOVED in 5 of 186 logs, no amount or stack figure in them; 806024 itself: 0 events (a passive); the bindmysoul talents snapshot in ~/CoaServer/reference lists the name only; nothing else found. Sizing (round 3): base pair 8 ran 10 trials per arm (9 treatment hits in the second run) and read +7.679% with a 99% half-width of 1.07 points, above the 1 point (half the 2-point band) the judge requires; the first run passed it. 20 trials per arm are the most one scenario holds (the 30 trials first tried exceed the 23 allowed, MAX_SCENARIO_MS 600000). The scaled projection 1.07 x sqrt(9/18) = 0.76 points is not what the residual rests on (at 0.76 the chance of a half-width above 1 is about 3% per run); it rests on the measured half-widths of four 20-trial runs on two pairs (0.46, 0.43, 0.42 and 0.48), under normal theory with about 16 degrees of freedom a half-width above 1 is about 2e-8 per run, and the estimate edge lies about 11 standard errors away, so the residual failure probability of a pair is far below the 0.1% limit on the measured spread. The sizing uses only the spread of base pair 8 and the pilot, never a mean as an expected value. Power (round rc): Radiant Flame 806060 costs 25% of the 1363 mana pool (Spell.dbc ManaCostPercentage 25), so only two casts fitted after the observed cast of the previous trial and the other casts of each trial were refused with NO_POWER (reason 85, pair 12). Two casts now fit (2 x 25% = 50% of the pool; the observed cast of the previous trial costs 33% (Horusath Blast) or 15% (Dawnsear)) and the pool is set to 1363 before every observed cast; a first design with three casts still refused the third in the Horusath Blast entry. void_on_cast_failure (round dawn, D-222, hit_ratio option of the same name): a refused cast in the run voids the trial (unmeasured).

behaviours.quote: Fulfilling your Vow now unleashes Sunlight restoring ${$704911m1+$BH*0.15} health to up to $704911i allies within $704911a1 yds, prioritizing the lowest health allies.
behaviours.name: Sunlight (heals at most 5 of 8 players, healthiest caster left out)

arms.source: The caster at 99% health is the healthiest of the eight, so the five lowest (allies at about 50%, large pools that regeneration does not refill) are healed and the caster is not: 5 Sunlight heals in all, 0 on the caster (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:155-160 orders by health percentage).

behaviours.observe_source: 92136 Effect[0] aura 42 PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL 704911; AscensionSunCleric.cpp:298-300 (Fulfill) heals with Sunlight 704911 the allies returned by Allies(player, player, Radius(704911), MaxAffectedTargets of 704911) (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:149-165): the caster and the units of the caster's raid within the radius, sorted by health percentage (lowest first, ties by GUID), cut to MaxAffectedTargets. 704911 MaxAffectedTargets = 5 ($704911i, the tooltip resolves 5 with the reference stats). Eight players stand in the raid (the caster and seven allies, ally_arm allies 7), all within the 40 yd radius, the seven allies set to 5000 of 10000 health (50%) in each phase, a pool that one out-of-combat regeneration tick (about 92 health per 2000 ms) cannot refill in the 3200 ms before Illumination, as in the 534267 cap entry. Dawn 804584 cast with 20 Solar Power 500149 set (harness precondition fixture), Vow of Radiance 803489 cast before it, Illumination 500143 (a direct heal) cast on the caster as in the heal entry; 92136 learned between the phases. Control (before): the same casts without 92136, no Sunlight heal. Heals are counted from the caster's own spell_heal_count of 704911, all targets. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 92136: 0 casts (a passive); no snapshot in ~/CoaServer/reference carries a target cap or an ordering beyond the tooltip; nothing found. The caster at 99% health is the healthiest of the eight, so the five lowest (allies at about 50%, large pools that regeneration does not refill) are healed and the caster is not: 5 Sunlight heals in all, 0 on the caster (AscensionSunCleric.cpp:155-160 orders by health percentage). Discrimination, stated: the seven allies hold the same percentage (about 50%), so the order shows only through the caster's health. Against a GUID order the check discriminates only if the caster's GUID is among the five lowest of the eight, which is not shown; against a random pick of five of eight both caster entries pass together with probability about (3/8 x 5/8)^2 = 5.5% per pair, not the 0.1% the rules ask. The priority wording therefore holds as the observed result of this layout, and a layout with spread health (some allies at 100%) would decide it alone. The before phase casts Dawn, so the after phase starts with Dawn 807440 removed by the harness (set_aura with 0 stacks in after_auras, a named precondition fixture, not the subject of the claim), and the after phase's Dawn cast always activates it, whatever the before phase left behind. Conversion round D-195 / D-196, 2026-11-22. Read time (mentor D-268): the trigger 500143 lands after its DBC cast time, so the read comes 2500 ms after the cast: 2000 ms cast plus the 500 ms margin of CAST_MARGIN_MS.

behaviours.name: Learning Light (spell haste on entering Sunrise)
behaviours.quote: Entering Sunset or Sunrise increases your spell haste by $301265s1%.
behaviours.observe_source: 300360 Learning Light Effect[0] aura 4 DUMMY; 301265 Learning Light Effect[0] aura 216 SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS, BasePoints 19 + 1 = 20 ($301265s1). SpendDawn (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:94-120) removes Sunrise/Sunset and enters the other one when Dawn is active, the spell cast spends it (a Holy or Fire spell of family 33 that does damage or heals), the caster has the specialization 92135 and Dawn's choice effect is set (ActivateDawn, AscensionSunCleric.cpp:263-270), and casts 301265 when the caster has 300360 (:116-117). A Holy spell enters Sunrise 500477, a Fire spell enters Sunset 500511 (:112-115). Dawn 804584 is cast for real with 20 Solar Power 500149 and the specialization 92135 as precondition fixtures (set_aura, neither is the subject) in both phases, and any Dawn left by the first phase is removed first (set_aura 807440 at 0 stacks), since a second Dawn cast cancels an active Dawn; 300360 is learned between the phases (control: the before reading, multiplier 1, same Dawn and same spell). The caster's engine cast speed multiplier is read after the spell; each aura 216 multiplies it by 100 / (100 + 20) (Unit.cpp:14967-14970, as the Glaring Rays entry), 1 / 1.2 = 0.833333, within 0.0001 (excludes 18% and 22%: 0.847458, 0.819672). Sunflare 800231 (Holy, SchoolMask 2) is cast at the dummy after Dawn: Sunrise is entered. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 301265 Learning Light: 101 SPELL_AURA_APPLIED and 102 SPELL_AURA_REMOVED in 3 logs (the haste aura exists in real play, no amount in the events), 300360 0 events (a passive); bindmysoul snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries "Entering Sunset or Sunrise increases your spell haste by 20%. Lasts for 10 seconds or 3 casts." (same figures); nothing else found.

behaviours.observe_source: 680643 Effect[0] aura 138 SPELL_AURA_MOD_MELEE_HASTE, EffectBasePoints 14 + 1 = 15 ($s1). attack_time_ms reads UNIT_FIELD_BASEATTACKTIME (hand 0), the hasted swing time: the Seraphim main hand 2524 swings in 2500 ms (class file weapon set Seraphim, spell_weapon_sets 680643), 2500 / 1.15 = 2173.913 ms with the passive and 2500 before it is learned (control; the harness trigger Holy Form 805301 is cast in both phases and the before reading shows it adds no haste). Deterministic stat read, judged to the rounding. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 680643: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) reads 'Increases your melee attack speed by 15% and your first auto attack on a target hits twice.'; the same Swift Justice 300322 entry reads the melee haste of another passive with the same metric; nothing else found. void_on_cast_failure: a refused cast in the run voids the trial (unmeasured), round rc (D-204, ADR 1207). Spacing (round rc): the after-arm cast is submitted 1600 ms after the before-arm cast (wait_ms + expire_ms), the global cooldown (StartRecoveryTime 1500 ms, Spell.dbc) plus 100 ms; pair 12 submitted it 1000 ms after and it was refused with NOT_READY (reason 67).

Run 1 (pair-less exploratory run 20261122-154829) with allies at 39 and 41 yd healed the 41 yd ally: the lead that showed the reach term; the arms are now 42.5 and 43.5 yd, 0.5 yd on each side of the computed edge, so a radius 10% smaller (36 yd, edge 39.0) or larger (44 yd, edge 47.0) fails one arm. behaviours.observe_source: 707528 Final Vows Effect[0] aura 107 and Effect[2] aura 107 carry no cooldown percent; the 10% is read by the class code (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:293-294: after a cast carrying the Dawn script value, with Vow of Grace 803719 and Final Vows on the caster, ReducePercent(player, id, |Amount(707528)|) with Amount from Effect[0] BasePoints 9 + 1 = 10). Fulfilment is set up as the Dawnguard control does: Vow of Grace 803719 cast, 20 Solar Power 500149 set on the caster (precondition fixture) and Dawn 804584 cast (it 'allows you to fulfill your Vows'), then Horusath Blast 500154 (Holy damage, RecoveryTime 25000, instant, its own cooldown, not a Gavel category) is cast at the dummy. Setup runs in the after phase only, so the before phase is a plain cast without any fulfilment: its read (24000 = 25000 - 1000) is a third control. The remaining cooldown of 500154 is read 1000 ms after the cast (game time 980..1020 ms): 25000 x 0.9 - 1000 = 21500 with the passive, 24000 without (control). A cut of 9% reads 21750 and 11% reads 21250, 250 ms away, so tolerance 150 excludes both. Control: 707528 is never learned (the learned gate is Angelic 704582): 24000, so the Vow alone cuts nothing. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 707528: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); the ascension-data snapshot rows read (advancement, class_spell, talent index) carry the acquisition of 707528 and no value; merged-PR and git log search --grep 707528: nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC for the value (the first author's search, b4b report).

behaviours.name: Harsh Lessons (Radiant Flame ticks every 0.5 s after Dawn)
behaviours.quote: Casting Dawn now grants Scorch Marks.
behaviours.observe_source: Tick model from the data (review I-3): Radiant Flame 806060 is channeled (AttributesEx 0x4), so Spell.cpp:4108 applies its aura at the cast without a missile delay (the scorch_duration entry reads 1700 ms remaining 300 ms after the cast of a 2000 ms aura, which shows no start delay). AttributesEx5 8704 = 0x2000 | 0x200: with SPELL_ATTR5_EXTRA_INITIAL_PERIOD the first amplitude is not added (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:758-763), so the first tick fires on apply, then every period P: the scorch_period readback gives 500, SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME -51 on EffectAmplitude 1000, times the cast speed factor. Each tick casts 807058 (Speed 45, not channeled), whose hit lands floor(max(distance, 5) / 45 x 1000) = 111 ms later (Spell.cpp:2468-2476, dummy at 3 yd). The damage events of 807058 on the dummy therefore land at d + 111 + k x P ms after the cast, d the unmeasured offset between the stamp origin and the channel start, 0 to about 50 ms (the stamps sit 9 to 18 ms after the requested waits in the earlier counted pairs). Landings: P = 450: 111, 561, 1011, 1461, 1911; P = 500: 111, 611, 1111, 1611, 2111; P = 550: 111, 661, 1211, 1761. Reads: 1511..1561 ms after the cast the count is 3 at P = 500 (1611 not yet) and 4 at P = 450 (1461 landed); 1661..1711 ms the count is 4 at P = 500 (1611 landed) and 3 at P = 550 (1761 not yet). Expected 3 then 4: P 10% shorter (450) fails the first read, P 10% longer (550) fails the second, each with a margin of at least 50 ms for d between 0 and 50 ms. The aura lasts 2000 ms with Scorch Marks (scorch_duration), so ticks at 0, 500, 1000 and 1500 ms exist. Control: scorch_ticks_control, the same cast with the unrelated passive Solar Conduit 300321 in place (P = 1000, landings 111, 1111, 2111), counts 2 at both reads. Dawn 804584 is the setup cast (Solar Power 500149 at 20 stacks, precondition fixture). Reference search 2026-11-22 (round 11 chunk d5 fix round): coa-history spell 804625: 0 events in 186 logs (a passive); bindmysoul snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) repeats the tooltip figures; nothing else found.

AscensionSunCleric.cpp:366-371 Refresh (every 500 ms SolarPower timer and on a cast of 561328/704585/805267/300314): health above 80% sets healthyAbove80, at or below 75% clears it, 76-80% keeps it (hysteresis set on purpose by b2ad6f76d6, #5963, fixes #5763/#5783; mentor D-153). The caster enters the read percent from another percent with 1000 ms settles (two timer periods), regeneration off. Entered from 50% and read at 79%: 1500 ms. One of the four edges named by D-153, judged by the tooltip literal (D-157). Trigger (round dawn, D-222, 2026-11-22): the claim does not need Dawn; Dawn 804584 was only the trigger cast between the two reads (chosen at the entry's creation, 9e2f148009), and it was refused in both phases in every retained run before round rc (CASTER_AURASTATE 22: no Solar Power). The read is a static spell modifier read that no trigger effect reaches, so Dawn and its fixtures (Solar Power 500149 x20, Dawn removed at the after start, its absent read) are taken out and Holy Form 805301 is the trigger, as for the class's other stat and modifier reads: its effects are healing done (aura 136), a dummy (aura 4, the Bless mana sacrifice on heals, AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:390) and threat (aura 10), none a spell modifier of cast time or cost. void_on_cast_failure: a refused cast in the run voids the trial (unmeasured), round rc (D-204, ADR 1207).

behaviours.quote: Lasts for $301265d or 3 casts.
behaviours.name: Learning Light (aura lasts 10 s)
behaviours.observe_source: 300360 Learning Light Effect[0] aura 4 DUMMY; 301265 Effect[0] aura 216 SPELL_AURA_HASTE_SPELLS, BasePoints 19 + 1 = 20, DurationIndex 1 = 10000 ms ($301265d). The script gives the aura 3 charges on application (AscensionSunClericAuras.cpp:97-99) and each finished Holy or Fire family 33 casting spell that was started under it spends one, removing it at the last (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:49, Finish at :83-88). Dawn 804584 is cast for real with 20 Solar Power 500149 and the specialization 92135 as precondition fixtures (set_aura, neither is the subject) in both phases, any Dawn left by the first phase removed first (set_aura 807440 at 0 stacks). Illumination 500143 (Holy, 2000 ms cast, heals the caster) is cast for real each time: the first cast spends Dawn and enters Sunrise, which grants 301265 only when 300360 is learned between the phases (control: the same casts before the learn read the haste multiplier 1). One real Illumination cast (2000 ms cast time, the aura is granted when it completes) with no later cast: the aura is present when read 11100..11700 ms after the cast started (game time), at least 9100 ms after it was granted, and gone when read 12400..12900 ms after it, at most 10900 ms after, so the duration lies inside 10% of 10000 ms (9000..11000) on both sides. Control: before the cast, absent. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 301265 Learning Light: 101 SPELL_AURA_APPLIED and 102 SPELL_AURA_REMOVED in 3 logs (the aura exists in real play, no amount or charge in the events), 300360 0 events (a passive); bindmysoul snapshot and ascension-data: nothing found beyond the tooltip.
