behaviours.name: Herald of Dawn (attackers swing under the Solar Flare)
behaviours.quote: reduces the target's chance to hit by
behaviours.observe_source: Solar Flare 807175 Effect[0] aura 54 SPELL_AURA_MOD_HIT_CHANCE BasePoints -3 ($s1 = 3), DurationIndex 10000 ms ($d), launched at the Dawnsear target by the Herald of Dawn route (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:213-214 casts 804631 when a Rapture 806477 cast completes with 804630 known, :353-356 casts Solar Flare 807175 when a Dawnsear 500146 hit finds the marker): each treatment cycle casts Rapture then Dawnsear at the one attacker (pre_cast, tool ADR 1199), and the aura from the caster is read on the attacker at every cycle end (a cycle without it makes the verdict unmeasured, never a miss sample). The attacker is one aggressive stationary Harvest Golem 36 at the class level melee-ing the caster; the control arm counts its swings and misses with no cast. Expected: the miss share rises by 3 points (the stated 3% of the DBC amount, never from a run), judged with the 99% interval of the difference and the band of 2 points. reset_cooldown and set_power are named precondition fixtures (G-21 point 6). The same aura is proven by the Sun Down entry attacker_miss of 572752; this entry proves the Herald route. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history has 0 events for 804630, 804631 and 500146 (no recorded cast of them); Solar Flare 807175 has 15499 damage events in 29 logs; bindmysoul has no Herald of Dawn entry; nothing found for the miss share. Precondition fixture named in the verdict: An'she's Guidance 681470 is learned in both arms (Effect[2] aura 149 REDUCE_PUSHBACK, BasePoints 99 + 1 = 100% of the pushback, so the attackers' hits do not delay the 3000 ms Rapture or the 3500 ms Dawnsear; the pushback_reduction entry of 681470 reads the same 100% in game time); it adds a Holy critical strike chance and changes no hit chance, the subject of this entry. The first design (b11d7, no pushback fixture) read unmeasured: Dawnsear refused with SPELL_IN_PROGRESS. Sizing (round rc): 24 parts pooled instead of 20, so the 99% half-width of the difference falls from 0.858 to about 0.78 and a correct server leaves the 2-point band with under 1e-4 per pair.

behaviours.name: Guiding Glow (Dawn is still active after 12 casts)
behaviours.quote: Allows Dawn to affect $s1 additional casts.
behaviours.observe_source: 300324 Guiding Glow Effect[0] aura 107 ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER MiscValue 4 (SPELLMOD_CHARGES), BasePoints 2 (+1 = 3, $s1), class mask word 0 = 64 = the Dawn state aura 807440 (ProcCharges 10). Each Useful cast under Dawn spends one charge (SpendDawn, AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:105-118 and :212-214: a spell with a heal or damage effect other than Dawn itself and Radiant Flame), and the aura ends on the last. Real cast route: Dawn 804584 is cast for real with 20 Solar Power 500149 set first (precondition fixture, the condition of Dawn, not the claim's subject), then 12 Gavel of Wrath 800617 casts at the dummy; the aura 807440 is read 500 ms after the last cast. Both phases make the same casts; 300324 is learned between them (the harness waits 61000 ms so the first Dawn has expired and the second cast activates rather than cancels it). Control (before): without the passive Dawn holds 10 charges and ends on the 10th cast, so it is gone after 12 casts. With it Dawn holds 13 charges: after 12 casts one remains (aura present, 1), so the passive adds at least 2 casts and, with consume_13, exactly 3. Together the 12-cast and 13-cast entries give exactly 13 = 10 + 3 affected casts, one more than the base figure and not 14. Reference search 2026-11-22: bindmysoul talents snapshot carries 'Allows Dawn to affect 3 additional casts.' for rank 1; coa-history and merged PRs give nothing beyond the tooltip and the DBC for this value. Design 2: run 1 (20261122-154829) with Illumination 500143 read the aura present in both phases, so the casts were not all made (Illumination costs 30% of base mana, ManaCostPercentage 30, and the setup casts refill only flat costs); Gavel of Wrath costs a flat 3 mana (ManaCost 3), which each setup cast refills, and a Gavel is Useful for SpendDawn (Gavel(info), AscensionSunCleric.cpp:171-174). Dawn is cast at the dummy: its effects target the caster. Run 2 (20261122-155337): consume_12 read present and consume_13 present as well; the trigger Gavel is not preceded by a cooldown reset (only setup casts reset), so it fell inside the 5000 ms category cooldown and the count was one short. Now all 12 Gavels are setup casts (each resets its cooldown) and the trigger is Holy Form 805301 (no damage or heal effect, not Useful: no charge spent), the read-only closing cast. Arms: the Dawn application count and the Gavel SPELL_GO count separate a cast that did not go off or a Dawn applied again from a charge that was not spent. Diagnostic readbacks of the earlier pass (b11d1) with the passive learned: 5/10/11/12/13/14 Gavels left 8/3/2/1/1/2 charges. The first pass of this design (setup_wait_ms 2600, pair 20261122 prove2 of this round) read the Gavel SPELL_GO arm 25 after the after phase against 26: one of the 13 casts did not go off in the after phase, so a Dawn with one charge left was a test fault, not a server reading; the wait between the setup casts is now 3600 ms (13 casts, the last about 47 s into the 60 s Dawn). Second design of the casts: Gavel of Grace 807987 (ManaCost 0 and ManaCostPercentage 0 in Spell.dbc, effects 121 normalized weapon damage and 31 weapon percent, so Useful(), AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:57-64) replaces Gavel of Wrath 800617 (ManaCostPercentage 10): with 800617 the 13th cast of the after phase did not go off in two passes (SPELL_GO arm 25 of 26, wait 2600 and 3600 ms). The aura 807440 is the metric itself, so no separate Dawn read is added.

arms.source: one Dawn cast 804584 per phase applies the state aura 807440 once (Effect of 804584, AscensionSunCleric.cpp:264-268 ActivateDawn), so the application count reads 1 after the before phase and 2 after the after phase when nothing reapplies it
12 Gavel of Grace 807987 setup casts per phase, each a SPELL_GO: 12 after the before phase and 24 after the after phase when every cast went off

behaviours.name: Rapture (pierces a full school immunity: Divine Shield on the dummy)
behaviours.quote: Call down a streak of sun light to smite your target, dealing ${$m1+0+$spfi*1.03734} Fire damage to them and nearby enemies, piercing all immunities, but dealing less damage with each enemy struck.
behaviours.observe_source: 807372 Rapture (rank 4 of 806477, the maximum rank at level 60): Effect[0] SCHOOL_DAMAGE, BasePoints 854 + 1, DieSides 65, RealPointsPerLevel 10.85 x (60 - BaseLevel 58) = 21.7, truncated to 21 (SpellInfo.cpp:497), and the roll adds irand(1, 65) (SpellInfo.cpp:509-511): 854 + 21 + 1..65 = 876..940; targets DEST_TARGET_ENEMY / UNIT_DEST_AREA_ENEMY, radius index 8; EffectDamageMultiplier[0] 0.85; Attributes bit 0x20000000 (SPELL_ATTR0_NO_IMMUNITIES, "piercing all immunities"); fire (SchoolMask 4), CastingTimeIndex 14 = 3000 ms, Speed 0, 20% mana, 20000 ms cooldown. Fixture 823764 (beeg spellpen) keeps the dummy's resistance out of the hit and 984954 keeps a critical strike out, both in both phases. The first phase casts nothing (control); the second casts the spell. The immunity is Divine Shield 642 on the dummy (set_aura, caster = the dummy, a named precondition fixture in both phases): Effect[1] aura 39 SPELL_AURA_SCHOOL_IMMUNITY MiscValue 127 (every school), Mechanic 29, DurationIndex 29 = 12000 ms, longer than the 3.8 s of the arm. arms.source: the caster's maximum mana is 2868 (BaseMana 1363 + 20 + 15 x (Intellect 119 - 20), StatSystem.cpp:421-429), the denominator of the mana fraction the code multiplies by; a different maximum voids the trial
the extra heal 807994 on the Bless ally, read as effective healing (the ally has 90000 missing health, so none is overhealed); none in the before phase (850, below 30%), one in the after phase (872)
the Daybreak 503624 heal the extra heal is taken from, effective healing on the Bless ally, one per phase
Empowered Holy Form 800602 is learned before both phases (learn [804247, 800602]); read present in both phases

ratios.source: Expected 872 / 2868 x 100 / 100 = 0.304042 (amount 50 doubled to 100 by 800602); truncation of one unit over the heal total is covered by floor_count, and the band 0.301 to 0.307 excludes the control's 0.152 and a 10% error either side (0.274, 0.334).

behaviours.observe_source: 805301 Holy Form Effect[1] aura 4 SPELL_AURA_DUMMY BasePoints 49 + 1 = 50 ($s2); 800602 Effect[0] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS BasePoints 99 + 1 = +100% on the class mask of Holy Form (Spell.dbc), so the amount is 100 with 800602 learned. AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:390-405: a heal with Holy Form on at or above 30% of maximum mana casts 807994 on the Bless ally for extra = healing x mana / maximum mana x amount / 100, truncated, and pays (extra + 3) / 4; 807994 carries SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS (Spell.dbc), so the heal takes no healing-done modifier of Holy Form or 800602. Same phases, setups and mana as ally_bless_mana: Bless 804247 at the ally and Holy Form 805301 on the caster 2000 ms apart, the caster's mana set to 2043 before the setup casts (Bless 272, Holy Form 545, Daybreak 354 taken from Spell.dbc ManaCostPercentage 20, 40, 26 of base mana 1363) so that 872 is the mana at the hook, against a maximum mana of 2868 (BaseMana 1363 + 20 + 15 x (Intellect 119 - 20), StatSystem.cpp:421-429); the before phase (2021, 850 at the hook, 29.6%) is below the gate and pays nothing, so the ratios read the after phase alone. The ally is set to 10000 of 100000 health so that no heal is capped by the missing health. Ratio of the 807994 heal total to the Daybreak 503624 heal total, both on the ally and read on the caster: Expected 872 / 2868 x 100 / 100 = 0.304042 (amount 50 doubled to 100 by 800602); truncation of one unit over the heal total is covered by floor_count, and the band 0.301 to 0.307 excludes the control's 0.152 and a 10% error either side (0.274, 0.334). void_on_cast_failure: a refused cast voids the trial (cast_failures are stated in the report). Arm 3 reads 800602 present in both phases. behaviours.name: Empowered Holy Form (Holy Form threat reduction doubled)
behaviours.quote: Doubles the effectiveness of your Holy Form and reduces the tick rate of Ancient Rites by $/1000;s2 sec.
behaviours.observe_source: 800602 Effect[0] aura 108 ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, EffectMiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), EffectBasePoints 99 + 1 = +100%, EffectSpellClassMask word 2 = 1048576 = SpellFamilyFlags[2] of Holy Form 805301 (family 33). 805301 Effect[2] aura 10 MOD_THREAT, EffectMiscValue 127 (all schools), EffectBasePoints -51 + 1 = -50% ($s3); doubled by 800602 the effect is -100%, so the damage threat of a Dawnsear 554406 cast is damage x 0. The flat initial threat of the cast, the SpellLevel 60 of 554406, is added with ignoreModifiers true (Spell.cpp:5736-5737, 5765), so threat per damage reads 0 + 60 / 8360.7 = 0.00718 (damage mean 708.5 + 10000 x 0.765222 = 8360.7, Dawnsear Description ${$m1+0+$spfi*0.765222}), the model of the Holy Form entries 0.50718 and 1.00718. Holy Form is cast for real after 800602 is learned (the before phase has neither the form nor a Dawnsear cast, so it reads 0). Control arm: the entry Holy Form (threat generated), same cast and spell power with the form alone, 0.50718, in the same pair. A threat cut of 10% off the doubled -100% (-90%) reads 0.107 and -50% reads 0.507, both far outside the 0.01 tolerance. The setup casts are spaced by setup_wait_ms 1600 ms (Holy Form global cooldown) and void_on_cast_failure voids a run with a refused cast. Expected from the DBC and the tooltip; nothing from a run. Reference search (G-11), prior round 2026-11-22 (ledger 317 reason): coa-history spell 800602: 0 events in 186 logs; bindmysoul talents snapshot (fetched 2026-07-22) carries only 'Doubles the effectiveness of your Holy Form.'; nothing else found.

Holy Form 805301 Effect[2] aura 10 MOD_THREAT -51 + 1 = -50% ($s3), so threat per damage = 0.5 + 60 / 8360.7 = 0.50718 (flat 60 = SpellLevel of 554406, Spell.cpp:5736-5737, 5765, ignoreModifiers); the treatment reads 0.00718 with 800602, 0.5 lower. behaviours.name: Vow of the Valkyr (1 Solar Power per auto attack landed)
behaviours.quote: Auto attacks generate 1 Solar Power
behaviours.observe_source: Vow of the Valkyr 807749 text: "Auto attacks generate 1 Solar Power". The count part of the clause, judged in one arm (same_arm_ratio, mentor D-260): right after each Solar Power 500149 reading the caster's melee_damage_count (auto attacks that dealt damage) is read at the same moment; between the control reading and the Vow reading lies only the Vow phase (both phases stop attacking before their reading), so the gain of the 500149 stacks over the gain of the landed auto attacks in that window is the Solar Power per auto attack: expected 1 from the tooltip, within 0.05, so one stack more or less over at least 5 landed attacks alerts. The window must hold at least 5 landed auto attacks, and the stacks must stay below the cap StackAmount 20 of 500149 (Spell.dbc, DurationIndex 21, no expiry), or the trial is unmeasured. Code: AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:114 (807749 on an automatic damaging hit) and :170-173. A refused cast voids the trial (void_on_cast_failure). Reference search: coa-history 807749 and 506823/506824 (Vow auto attack events), bindmysoul 807749 text identical; nothing found that gives a per-attack Solar Power rate beyond the tooltip.

same_arm_ratio.source: tooltip of 807749 "Auto attacks generate 1 Solar Power": 1 stack of 500149 per auto attack landed

behaviours.name: Solar Concord (Solar Flare damage from Rapture in Sunset at +5000 spell power)
behaviours.quote: and causes their damage dealt to launch a Solar Flare.
behaviours.observe_source: Out-of-sample arm (mentor D-260): a spell power and phase combination never run before, its value predicted and committed before its first run. Setup as flare_damage_rapture: Solar Concord 301266 cast for real in the second phase only (setup_only_after), Rapture rank 4 807372 the trigger in both phases (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:132-133 procs Solar Flare 807175 on a damaging Rapture 806477 hit while the caster has Sunset 500511), Sunset 500511, 984954 (no critical strike) and 823764 (no resistance) set in both phases as precondition fixtures, the control phase reads 0. Prediction from the tooltip and the DBC (/srv/coa/server-data/dbc) at +5000 spell power (the player fixture, both phases): Solar Flare 807175 tooltip ${$m2+$ppl2+$SP*0.26}; Effect[1] BasePoints 50, RealPointsPerLevel 1.9, DieSides 1, BaseLevel 15, so the engine base is 50 + int32(45 x 1.9 = 85.5) = 85, plus the 1..1 roll: 136 (SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue, SpellInfo.cpp:496-518, integer before the roll); the spell power term is int32(5000 x 0.26) = 1300 (Unit::SpellDamageBonusDone, Unit.cpp:9967, level penalty 1 with MaxLevel 0); Sunset 500511 Effect[1] aura 79 MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE MiscValue 4 (Fire), BasePoints 9 + 1 = +10%, and Solar Flare SchoolMask 6 (Holy and Fire) carries Fire, so (136 + 1300) x 1.10 = 1579.6, truncated to 1579 (Unit.cpp:9970 and :9982); the band 1579..1580 also admits the tooltip reading (136.5 + 1300) x 1.10 = 1580.15. Sunset Effect[0] aura 71 (+20% Fire spell critical chance) is held off by 984954. A refused cast voids the trial (void_on_cast_failure).

behaviours.quote: Melee critical strikes against you prevent you from being critically struck again for $301342d.
behaviours.name: Stalwart (the immunity is still held just before 4 s)

apply_stamp.source: 301342 DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms ($301342d, SpellDuration.dbc); a held reading from 3620 ms excludes 3600 ms, 10% off

behaviours.observe_source: 300355 Stalwart Effect[0] aura 42 (proc trigger of 301342); 301342 Stalwart has DurationIndex 35 = 4000 ms ($301342d, SpellDuration.dbc) and Effect[0] aura 197 SPELL_AURA_MOD_ATTACKER_SPELL_AND_WEAPON_CRIT_CHANCE, EffectBasePoints -1001 + 1 = -1000%, the immunity. The server grants it on a received melee critical hit with damage (AscensionSunClericEvents.cpp:102-103, :276). The critical melee hit is real: the striker's Hateful Strike 28308 (D-277: replaces Strike 11976, which can miss; DmgClass 2, melee, SPELL_ATTR3_ALWAYS_HIT in AttributesEx3, Spell.dbc) hits the caster, and Vulnerable 213 (Effect[1] aura 197, EffectBasePoints 9999 + 1 = +10000% to be critically struck, the fixture of Witch Hunter Alertness 681152) set by harness set_aura makes it critical; Vulnerable is a precondition fixture, not the subject. 300355 is learned between the phases, so the before phase is the control (the same crit, no talent, aura 301342 absent). The aura is read on the caster at a game time measured from the trigger cast Angelic Presence 800722 (an instant self cast, only the clock). An encounter timeline (apply_stamp, ADR 1236) opened before the after phase's Strikes stamps every apply of 301342 on the caster and the clock cast in one game-time base, so the reading is bracketed from the aura apply itself: at least the game time from just after the clock cast, with no apply stamped after it, and at most the game time from just before the clock cast plus the clock cast minus the first apply. The aura starts at the landing and lasts D = 4000 ms ($301342d, DBC). The bracket must lie in 3620 to 3990 ms after the apply: a held reading there needs D > 3620 ms, which excludes a duration 10% short (3600 ms), and stays below D = 4000. Reference search 2026-11-22: coa-history spell 300355 and 301342: see the Stalwart passive, no logged event; nothing found beyond the tooltip and the server DBC. Four Hateful Strikes 28308 are cast 20 ms apart (strike count 4) with the caster's dodge and parry set to 0 (caster_avoidance): Unit::MeleeSpellHitResult returns SPELL_MISS_NONE for SPELL_ATTR3_ALWAYS_HIT (Unit.cpp:3752-3753), so no Strike misses; the earlier alert of this entry (a first pair run read it once ok and once alert, aura absent, with Strike 11976) was a missed Strike and cannot recur. Vulnerable makes every landing critical, so the aura starts at the first landing within 60 ms of the first Strike. void_on_cast_failure: a refused cast voids the trial (cast_failures are stated in the report). Residual failure probability: no probabilistic step remains.

target_aura_gates.name: Justicar's Wrath
target_aura_gates.quote: and increasing the target's spell damage taken by $572067s1% for $572067d.
target_aura_gates.reason: Cause of the plain 806980 hit_mean alert (lr1 TN-5): every judged hit lands on the same dummy, and each landed hit casts Justicar's Wrath's debuff 572067 on it (AscensionSunClericAbilities.cpp:341-342, info->Id == 806980: Cast(player, target, 572067)): 572067 Effect[0] aura 87 SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_TAKEN, MiscValue 126 (Holy, Fire, Nature, Frost, Shadow, Arcane), BasePoints 9 + DieSides 1 = 10% ($572067s1), DurationIndex 8 = 15000 ms, StackAmount 0, while the hit scenario casts every 2000 ms; so every hit after the first is +10%: the model 472.05 x 1.10 = 519.26 against the measured 518.3 (846 hits). The model's 472.05 sits 12.1% under the tooltip mean 536.81 because the tooltip mean carries no mitigation and the model applies the linear monster resistance the server uses for a creature (Unit::GetEffectiveResistChance, Unit.cpp:2563-2606, CoA.MonsterResistance.PerLevel 1.0 x dummy level 60 = 60 resistance, PerPercent 5: 12% average resist, the 11 partial-resist steps of CalcAbsorbResist): neither figure is computed wrongly. These arms give each hit a clean target: the gate fixture sets 572067 at 0 stacks on the dummy before every cast (stacks 0 arm, expected the model mean) and at 1 stack (the cap arm, StackAmount 0 counts as 1, expected the model mean x 1.10 from $572067s1). The plain 806980 hit_mean stays an alert of the scenario design, cited by no clause.
